(C) uberon-2001408.description: (C): Infraorbital that is the third bone of the infraorbital series.

(C) uberon-2001409.description: (C): Infraorbital that is the fourth bone of the infraorbital series.

(C) uberon-2001415.description: (C): Pelvic fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2201415.description: (C): Pelvic fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2001416.description: (C): Pelvic fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2201416.description: (C): Pelvic fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2001417.description: (C): Pelvic fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2201417.description: (C): Pelvic fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2001418.description: (C): Lepidotrichium which is part of the dorsal fin.

(C) uberon-4000177.description: (C): Lepidotrichium that is part of the dorsal fin skeleton.

(C) uberon-2001419.description: (C): A range of seven to nine rod-like internal median skeletal support structures of the dorsal fin, comprised of both bone and cartilage and found between vertebrae 11 and 18.

(C) uberon-2001420.description: (C): A range of twelve to fourteen rod-like internal median skeletal support structures of the anal fin, comprised of both bone and cartilage and found between vertebrae 14 and 21.

(C) uberon-2001421.description: (C): Lepidotrichium which is part of the anal fin.

(C) uberon-4000176.description: (C): Lepidotrichium that is part of the anal fin skeleton.

(C) uberon-2001432.description: (C): Sclerotic bone that is located anterior to the eye.

(C) uberon-2001433.description: (C): Sclerotic bone that is located posterior to the eye.

(C) uberon-2001437.description: (C): The constriction between the anterior and posterior chambers of the swim bladder. There does not appear to be an identifiable sphincter in the ductus, and therefore other musculature may regulate its opening. Finney et al, 2006.

(C) uberon-2001450.description: (C): Apical ectodermal ridge that is part of the pelvic fin.

(C) uberon-2001456.description: (C): A plate-like chondrogenic condensation within the pectoral fin, which subdivides into individual radials by decomposition of extracellular matrix in the inter-radial mesenchyme (Grandel and Schulte-Merker, 1998).

(C) uberon-2002284.description: (C): Surface structure that is a visible mark on the body resulting from pigmentation.

(C) uberon-2005117.description: (C): A migrating group of cells originating from an anterior lateral line placode. The primordium deposits neuromasts and interneuromasts between them during its migration.

(C) uberon-2001472.description: (C): Neuromast that is part of the anterior lateral line. Kimmel et al, 1995. (Also see Anatomical Atlas entry for lateral line by T. Whitfield.).

(C) uberon-2001473.description: (C): Cells (completely cleaved), located underneath the superficial blastomeres and internal to the marginal blastomeres. Kimmel et al, 1995.

(C) uberon-2001474.description: (C): Anatomical cluster consisting of the paired sublingual dorsal ossification and sublingual ventral ossification.

(C) uberon-2001532.description: (C): Sublingual cartilage that is the dorsal element paired with the sublingual ventral cartilage.

(C) uberon-2001545.description: (C): Sublingual cartilage that is the ventral element paired with the sublingual dorsal cartilage.

(C) uberon-2001480.description: (C): Nerve fibers originating from the dorsal anterior lateral line ganglion. These rami innervate the otic, supraorbital, and infraorbital neuromasts.

(C) uberon-2001481.description: (C): Nerve fibers originating from the ventral anterior lateral line ganglion. These rami innervate the mandibular and opercular neuromasts.

(C) uberon-2001482.description: (C): Nerve fibers originating from the middle lateral line ganglion. These fibers innervate the middle lateral line.

(C) uberon-2001483.description: (C): The middle lateral line ganglion develops from a cranial ectodermal placode and contains sensory neurons that innervate the middle lateral line.

(C) uberon-2001484.description: (C): Cells (completely cleaved), located at the surface of the blastodisc, above the deep blastomeres. Kimmel et al, 1995.

(C) uberon-2001502.description: (C): Bilaterally paired medial bar of cartilage formed at midorbit through medial chondrification from triangles of cartilage that later form the junction of the taeniae marginales anterior, taeniae marginales posterior and the epiphyseal bar.

(C) uberon-2001504.description: (C): Cranial cartilage which is a paired anterodorsal projection of the posterior end of the parachordal cartilage. It lies lateral to the notochord, just anterior to the posterior tip of the otic capsule. The bilaterally paired occipital arch cartilages fuse anterodorsally to the posterior edges of the auditory capsules and meet medially as the tectum synoticum (by 12 dpf).

(C) uberon-2001505.description: (C): Cartilage bar (bilaterally paired) that grows anteroventrally from the epiphyseal bar to join the anterolatera1 edge of the ethmoid plate.

(C) uberon-2001508.description: (C): Cartilage formed via medial fusion between bilaterally paired trabecula crani.

(C) uberon-2001544.description: (C): Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is the median cartilage of the ventral hyoid arch, generally lying between the paired ventral hypohyals.

(C) uberon-2001540.description: (C): Small cartilage that forms at the posterior and medial edge of the basipterygium.

(C) uberon-2001541.description: (C): Small cartilage with a long posterior process and a shorter lateral one that forms at the posterior edge of the basipterygium, between radial cartilages 1 and 2.

(C) uberon-2001542.description: (C): Small cartilage that forms at the posterior and lateral edge of the basipterygium.

(C) uberon-2001546.description: (C): Neural spine that is associated with the fourth vertebra.

(C) uberon-2001550.description: (C): Lepidotrichium which is part of the caudal fin.

(C) uberon-4000174.description: (C): Lepidotrichium that is part of the caudal fin skeleton.

(C) uberon-2001551.description: (C): Lepidotrichium which is part of the pectoral fin, forming the pectoral fin skeleton and articulating with the pectoral radials. A pectoral lepidotrichium is composed of two hemitrichia that surround bundles of actinotrichia distally.

(C) uberon-4000175.description: (C): Lepidotrichium that is part of the pectoral fin skeleton.

(C) uberon-2001552.description: (C): Lepidotrichium which is part of the pelvic fin.

(C) uberon-4000173.description: (C): Lepidotrichium that is part of the pelvic fin skeleton.

(C) uberon-2001554.description: (C): Dermal bone that is rod-like, formed and usually contained in a fin membrane, and jointed to or adjacent to distal radials. Lepidotrichia are formed from paired hemitrichia surrounding actinotrichia. There are usually two more lepidotrichia than distal radials.

(C) uberon-4000172.description: (C): Dermal bone that is rod-like, formed and usually contained in a fin membrane, and jointed to or adjacent to distal radials. Lepidotrichia are formed from paired hemitrichia surrounding actinotrichia. There are usually two more lepidotrichia than distal radials.

(C) uberon-2001577.description: (C): Process of the premaxilla that extends posteriorly and overlays the mesethmoid.

(C) uberon-2001578.description: (C): In cypriniforms the anterior portion of the palatine has a dorsomedial process which abuts against the mesethmoid. Such a process is not present in other ostariophysans or in other primitive teleosts.

(C) uberon-2001579.description: (C): Ural vertebra that is the second vertebra posterior to preural centrum 1. It may bear a rudimentary neural arch and sometimes a rudimentary spine or the neural arch and spine are completely absent and it may articulate or fuse with hypural 2 (polyural terminology). Ural vertebra 2 is an unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2001581.description: (C): A vertebral centrum that is located immediately posterior to ural centrum 1. Ural centrum 2 is an unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2002085.description: (C): A vertebral centrum that is posterior to preural vertebra 1 and consequently the most posterior vertebral centra. Ural centrum is a unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2001583.description: (C): Urostyle that is the result of fusion of preural centrum 1 with the first ural centrum (of polyural terminology).

(C) uberon-2001584.description: (C): Caudal fin lepidotrichium that form part of the anterior dorsal and ventral series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin that may be associated with a neural spine or an epural or an uroneural (dorsal series) and with a haemal spine of a preural vertebra (ventral series). Caudal procurrent rays are shorter than the caudal principal rays. A caudal procurrent ray is an unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2001585.description: (C): Caudal fin lepidotrichium that is adjacent to a branched ray. Caudal principal rays may be segmented but unbranched and the main element forming the dorsal or ventral leading margin of the caudal fin or a ray that may be only segmented-and-branched and forms part of the middle-posterior region of the fin. A caudal principal ray is an unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2002164.description: (C): Anatomical cluster including all segmented-and-branched rays plus one unbranched but segmented ray located at the leading margin in each lobe of the caudal fin (Hubbs and Lagler, 1947) and that associates with endoskeletal elements such as hypurals and hemal spines of preural centra 1 and 2 (Arratia, 2008). Caudal principal rays are counted from the dorsalmost one ventrally. Caudal principal rays are unpaired median bones.

(C) uberon-2001586.description: (C): Pectoral fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2101586.description: (C): Pectoral fin radial elements are the internal skeletal supports of the pectoral fin which develop from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc, supports the pectoral lepidotrichia or fin rays and connects the lepidotrichia with the primary pectoral girdle.

(C) uberon-2201586.description: (C): Pectoral fin radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2001587.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2101587.description: (C): Pectoral fin radial element which develops from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc, supports a few pectoral lepidotrichia or fin rays and connects the lepidotrichia and distal radial elements with the primary pectoral girdle (scapula and coracoid).

(C) uberon-2001588.description: (C): Pectoral fin distal radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2101588.description: (C): Pectoral fin radial element that sometimes ossifies, develops from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc, and is located at the proximal region of a lepidotrichium, between its hemitrichia. Pectoral fin distal radial element is paired.

(C) uberon-2201588.description: (C): Pectoral fin distal radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2001589.description: (C): The propterygium is the lateralmost or anteriormost basal cartilage that originates from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc. The bases of the pectoral lepidotrichium 1 plus the propterygium articulates with the scapula.

(C) uberon-2001592.description: (C): Endochondral bone, membrane bone, and Weberian ossicle that is located dorsal to the scaphium. The claustrum bone is bilaterally paired.

(C) uberon-2001593.description: (C): Surface structure that is the dorsal portion of the caudal fin.

(C) uberon-2001594.description: (C): Surface structure that is the ventral portion of the caudal fin.

(C) uberon-2001603.description: (C): Process that is the upper portion of the maxilla that rests on the posterior surface of the lateral portion of the premaxilla.

(C) uberon-2001604.description: (C): Lateral bony projection proximal to lateral ethmoid-palatine joint, and located anterior to orbital region and posterior to olfactory region.

(C) uberon-2001606.description: (C): Scute that is a median bony plate forming anterior to procurrent caudal fin rays.

(C) uberon-2001607.description: (C): Process that is the paired process of the parasphenoid that articulates with the suspensorium.

(C) uberon-2001609.description: (C): Bony projection that is part of the pharyngobranchial 2 bone.

(C) uberon-2001610.description: (C): An endochondral bone that is the dorsally-oriented bony extension of the quadrate, extending from the anterior portion of the bone.

(C) uberon-2001611.description: (C): Process that is the posterior extension of the quadrate and located dorsal to the quadrate ventral process.

(C) uberon-2001612.description: (C): Multi-tissue structure that is a fluid-filled canal in the integument and usually dermal bones, and contains one or more neuromast organs.

(C) uberon-2001613.description: (C): Dorsal fin middle radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2101613.description: (C): Dorsal fin radial element that is the rod-like internal median skeletal support element of the dorsal fin located between the dorsal fin proximal radial element and dorsal fin distal radial element.

(C) uberon-2201613.description: (C): Dorsal fin middle radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2001614.description: (C): Anal fin middle radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2101614.description: (C): Anal fin radial element that is the rod-like internal median skeletal support element of the anal fin located between the anal fin proximal radial element and anal fin distal radial element.

(C) uberon-2201614.description: (C): Anal fin middle radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2001615.description: (C): Process of the sphenotic. The process may project antero-laterally or laterally or ventro-laterally and it has different development in different fish groups. The sphenotic spine is paired.

(C) uberon-2001616.description: (C): Superficial and lateral bony projection anterior to orbital region. Sometimes with superficial ornamentation where in direct contact with skin.

(C) uberon-2001617.description: (C): Sensory canal on trunk which is posterior to the pectoral girdle and often reaching to or onto the caudal fin. The trunk sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

(C) uberon-2001630.description: (C): Sensory canal that crosses over the dorsal midline and in close proximity to the contralateral post-otic sensory canals. The supratemporal sensory canal is unpaired.

(C) uberon-2001619.description: (C): Sensory canal between and in close proximity to the trunk sensory canal and anteriorly with the otic and preoperculo-mandibular sensory canals. The post-otic sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

(C) uberon-2001873.description: (C): Lateral line system on head and pectoral girdle.

(C) uberon-2001622.description: (C): Multi-tissue structure composed of enameloid and dentine surrounding a pulp cavity, and found either attached to dermal bone or freely in the skin.

(C) uberon-2001623.description: (C): Odontode that is attached to dermal bone.

(C) uberon-2001624.description: (C): Odontode that is attached to the skin and without association to dermal bone.

(C) uberon-2001629.description: (C): Sensory canal between and in close proximity posteriorly with the post-otic and preoperculo-mandibular sensory canals, and anteriorly with the supraorbital and infraorbital sensory canals. The otic sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

(C) uberon-2001632.description: (C): Tooth that is attached to the ectopterygoid bone.

(C) uberon-2001633.description: (C): Tooth that is attached to the entopterygoid bone.

(C) uberon-2001634.description: (C): Most anterior pharyngobranchial cartilage, located medial to the epibranchials.

(C) uberon-2001910.description: (C): Most anterior pharyngobranchial element, located medial to the epibranchials.

(C) uberon-2001635.description: (C): Most anterior pharyngobranchial bone, located medial to the epibranchials.

(C) uberon-2001636.description: (C): Most posterior pharyngobranchial bone, located medial to the epibranchials.

(C) uberon-2001640.description: (C): Perichordal bone that surrounds the anterior tip of the notochord.

(C) uberon-2001648.description: (C): Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to the basihyal cartilage or bone.

(C) uberon-2001649.description: (C): Tooth that is attached to the basihyal tooth plate.

(C) uberon-2001650.description: (C): Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 2 bone.

(C) uberon-2002015.description: (C): Dermal bone of upper pharyngeal arches associated with pharyngobranchial bones or cartilages, usually bearing teeth.

(C) uberon-2001651.description: (C): Tooth that is attached to the pharyngobranchial 2 tooth plate.

(C) uberon-2001652.description: (C): Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 3 bone.

(C) uberon-2001653.description: (C): Tooth that is part of the pharyngobranchial 3 tooth plate.

(C) uberon-2001654.description: (C): Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 4, and located anterior to upper pharyngeal 5 tooth plate.

(C) uberon-2001655.description: (C): Tooth that is attached to the upper pharyngeal 4 tooth plate.

(C) uberon-2001656.description: (C): Pharyngeal toothplate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 4, and located posterior to upper pharyngeal 4 tooth plate.

(C) uberon-2001657.description: (C): Tooth that is attached to the upper pharyngeal 5 tooth plate.

(C) uberon-2001658.description: (C): Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchials 3 and 4.

(C) uberon-2001659.description: (C): Tooth that is attached to the upper pharyngeal tooth plate.

(C) uberon-2001660.description: (C): Tooth that is part of the basibranchial tooth plate.

(C) uberon-2001661.description: (C): Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to basibranchials 1-3.

(C) uberon-2001662.description: (C): Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to basibranchial 4 bone.

(C) uberon-2001663.description: (C): Tooth that is attached to the basibranchial 4 tooth plate.

(C) uberon-2001664.description: (C): Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to basibranchial 2 bone.

(C) uberon-2001665.description: (C): Tooth that is attached to the basibranchial 2 tooth plate.

(C) uberon-2001666.description: (C): Neural arch on the urostyle. It does not support a neural spine. Sanger and McCune 2002.

(C) uberon-2101671.description: (C): Anal fin radial elements are internal skeletal supports of the anal fin.

(C) uberon-2005225.description: (C): Median fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2201671.description: (C): Anal fin radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2101672.description: (C): Dorsal fin radial elements are internal skeletal supports of the dorsal fin.

(C) uberon-2201672.description: (C): Dorsal fin radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2001674.description: (C): Infraorbital that is the sixth bone of the infraorbital series.

(C) uberon-2001675.description: (C): Bony projection that extends from the mesethmoid anteriorly. Mesethmoid cornua are paired processes each articulating with its ipsilateral premaxilla and both cornua bounding a median mesethmoid cleft.

(C) uberon-2001676.description: (C): Joint that articulates the mesethmoid and premaxilla. Mesethmoid-premaxillary joint is paired.

(C) uberon-2001950.description: (C): Joint that articulates the left and right premaxillary bones. Inter-premaxillary joint is unpaired.

(C) uberon-2001677.description: (C): Joint that articulates the mesethmoid and nasal. Mesethmoid-nasal joint is paired.

(C) uberon-2001678.description: (C): Joint that articulates the mesethmoid and frontal. Mesethmoid-frontal joint is paired.

(C) uberon-2001680.description: (C): Joint that articulates the mesethmoid and vomer. Mesethmoid-vomer joint is unpaired.

(C) uberon-2001681.description: (C): Bony projection that is mesially-directed and off the anteromedial corner of each mesethmoid cornu.

(C) uberon-2001683.description: (C): Ligament that is attached to supracleithrum and basioccipital.

(C) uberon-2001684.description: (C): Membrane bone that is fused to supracleithrum and is jointed to basioccipital and exoccipital.

(C) uberon-2001685.description: (C): Lateral ethmoid-ectopterygoid ligament is a ligament that connects the lateral ethmoid to the ectopterygoid.

(C) uberon-2001686.description: (C): The bony shelf above orbit is an anatomical cluster formed by the dorsolateral portions of the lateral ethmoid, frontal and sphenotic bones that forms the dorsal margin of the orbit.

(C) uberon-2001687.description: (C): Interopercular-mandibular ligament is a ligament that connects the interopercle to an element of the lower jaw, typically the retroarticular.

(C) uberon-2001688.description: (C): Cartilage that is separate from and anterior to the pterygoquadrate cartilage.

(C) uberon-2001689.description: (C): Pterygoquadrate cartilage - cartilage that is separate from and posterior to the palatine cartilage.

(C) uberon-2001690.description: (C): Anterior cartilage of palatine - cartilage that caps the anterior end of the autopalatine bone. It is typically present in adults.

(C) uberon-2001691.description: (C): Posterior cartilage of palatine - cartilage that caps the posterior end of the autopalatine bone. It is typically present in adults.

(C) uberon-2001692.description: (C): Dermal bone that is located in the middle of the upper jaw, independently formed by fusion of tooth bases attached to soft tissue in the middle portion of the upper lip. The median premaxilla bears teeth in adults.

(C) uberon-2001693.description: (C): Muscle located in the lateral region of the cheek, linking the lateral surface of opercle with the posterolateral margin of the suspensorium (usually the preopercle).

(C) uberon-2001694.description: (C): Ligament that links the tip of the postcleithral process of the cleithrum with either the vertebral column (at the vertebral parapophysis or rib of the sixth vertebra) or with the soft tissue around the postcleithral region.

(C) uberon-2001695.description: (C): Pharyngeal arch cartilage, elongate and usually bifurcated posteriorly, located anteriorly on the upper branchial arches, attached to the anterior tips of the first infrapharyngobranchials. It supports rows of gill rakers on each side and is not homologous to other structures in the teleost gill-arch skeleton. One or two mediopharyngobranchials may be present.

(C) uberon-2001696.description: (C): Pharyngeal arch cartilage present on the dorsal surface of the middle portion of the upper branchial arches, dorsal to the point of contact between the second and third infrapharyngobranchials. It is round or cylyndrical in shape. Not homologous to the mediopharyngobranchial.

(C) uberon-2001697.description: (C): Endochondral bone, which may be ossified or not in adults, located immediately anteriorly to the pterygiophore series of the anal fin. The structure is usually cylindrical, and its plane of symmetry is transverse to that of pterygiophores and fin rays.

(C) uberon-2001698.description: (C): Endochondral bone located posterior to the last anal fin pterygiophore. The anal fin stay is a median bone.

(C) uberon-2001699.description: (C): Endochondral bone located posterior to the last dorsal fin pterygiophore. The dorsal fin stay is a median bone.

(C) uberon-2001700.description: (C): Dermal bone that is located anterior to the caudal fin procurrent rays. Caudal fin stays are unpaired median bones.

(C) uberon-2001701.description: (C): Basibranchial bone that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 5 (pharyngeal arch 7). Develops in posterior copula cartilage or basibranchial 5 cartilage.

(C) uberon-2001919.description: (C): Skeletal element that is median and associated with branchial arch 5.

(C) uberon-2001866.description: (C): Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 5 (pharyngeal arch 7).

(C) uberon-2001702.description: (C): Infraorbital that is the seventh bone of the infraorbital series.

(C) uberon-2001703.description: (C): Infraorbital that is the eighth bone of the infraorbital series.

(C) uberon-2001704.description: (C): Infraorbital that is the ninth bone of the infraorbital series.

(C) uberon-2001705.description: (C): Infraorbital that is the tenth bone of the infraorbital series.

(C) uberon-2001706.description: (C): Infraorbital that is the eleventh bone of the infraorbital series.

(C) uberon-2001707.description: (C): Infraorbital that is the twelfth bone of the infraorbital series.

(C) uberon-2001708.description: (C): Infraorbital that is the last bone of the infraorbital series, carrying the infraorbital canal, and sometimes also the supraorbital, temporal, and/or preopercular canals. The dermosphenotic is sometimes sutured or fused completely to the skull, e.g. to the autosphenotic.

(C) uberon-2001713.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is the dorsalmost caudal principal ray of the caudal fin.

(C) uberon-2001714.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 1.

(C) uberon-2001715.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 2.

(C) uberon-2001716.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 3.

(C) uberon-2001717.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 4.

(C) uberon-2001718.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 5.

(C) uberon-2001719.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 6.

(C) uberon-2001720.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 7.

(C) uberon-2001721.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 8.

(C) uberon-2001722.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 9.

(C) uberon-2001723.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 10.

(C) uberon-2001724.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 11.

(C) uberon-2001725.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 12.

(C) uberon-2001726.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 13.

(C) uberon-2001727.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 14.

(C) uberon-2001728.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 15.

(C) uberon-2001729.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 16.

(C) uberon-2001730.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 17.

(C) uberon-2001731.description: (C): Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 18.

(C) uberon-2001732.description: (C): Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 4.

(C) uberon-2002054.description: (C): Joint between the centra, and sometimes the neural arches or parapophyses.

(C) uberon-2001733.description: (C): Bony projection that is the posterolaterally oriented projection on the ventral region of the mesethmoid. Mesethmoid ventral diverging lamellae are paired and posteriorly contact the lateral ethmoid bones.

(C) uberon-2001734.description: (C): Process that is the posteriorly oriented, paired projection of the basipterygium.

(C) uberon-2001735.description: (C): Foramen that is located in the scapula. The scapular foramen is paired and formed by a ring of bone.

(C) uberon-2001737.description: (C): Foramen that is located in the coracoid.

(C) uberon-2001739.description: (C): Fontanel that is located between the contralateral frontals and anterior to the epiphyseal bar.

(C) uberon-2001740.description: (C): Fontanel that is located posterior to the epiphyseal bar, and typically located between the contralateral frontals and parietals (if present) and bordered posteriorly by the supraoccipital.

(C) uberon-2001741.description: (C): Foramen through which branches of cranial nerves V (trigeminal) and VII (facial) exit.

(C) uberon-2001742.description: (C): Foramen through which cranial nerve VIII (auditory) exits.

(C) uberon-2001744.description: (C): Anatomical space within a bone in which teeth develop.

(C) uberon-2001745.description: (C): Replacement tooth trench that is located in the premaxilla.

(C) uberon-2001746.description: (C): Replacement tooth trench that is located in the dentary.

(C) uberon-2001747.description: (C): Bony projection located on the anteroventral region of the mesethmoid which articulates with the premaxilla.

(C) uberon-2001748.description: (C): Foramen through which the superficial ophthalmic nerve passes.

(C) uberon-2001749.description: (C): Joint that articulates the dentary and anguloarticular. Dentary-anguloarticular joint is paired.

(C) uberon-2001750.description: (C): Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the sixth centrum.

(C) uberon-2001751.description: (C): Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the fifth centrum.

(C) uberon-2001752.description: (C): The pre-narial cartilage is a cartilage that is located anterior to the anterior naris.

(C) uberon-2001753.description: (C): Fossa where the exoccipital forms the medial portion and the epioccipital forms the lateral margin. The posttemporal fossa in most species has two openings separated by the epioccipital bridge.

(C) uberon-4300116.description: (C): Soft ray that is part of the dorsal fin.

(C) uberon-2001761.description: (C): Pectoral fin lepidotrichium 1 is the leading or marginal ray of the fin and articulates with the scapula. Lepidotrichium 1 is commonly segmented but unbranched but occasionally may be a massive strong unsegmented element (e.g., spine).

(C) uberon-4500007.description: (C): Soft ray that is part of the pectoral fin.

(C) uberon-2001762.description: (C): Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the second most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

(C) uberon-2001763.description: (C): Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the third most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

(C) uberon-2001764.description: (C): Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the fourth most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

(C) uberon-2001765.description: (C): Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the fifth most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

(C) uberon-2001766.description: (C): Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the sixth most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

(C) uberon-2001767.description: (C): Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the seventh most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

(C) uberon-2001768.description: (C): Bilaterally paired dorsal hyoid arch muscle that retracts the maxillary barbel.

(C) uberon-4500006.description: (C): Soft ray that is part of the anal fin.

(C) uberon-4300117.description: (C): Soft ray that is part of the pelvic fin.

(C) uberon-2001783.description: (C): Process that is part of the supraoccipital. It is a posteriorly directed and unpaired median projection off the posterior margin of the supraoccipital bone.

(C) uberon-2001787.description: (C): Pectoral-fin lepidotrichium 1 with mostly co-ossified and unsegmented hemitrichia that form a stiff and usually thick shaft and enlarged basal processes that moveably articulate with the pectoral girdle. The pectoral fin spine may also result from the fusion of several lepidotrichia that form a stiff shaft.

(C) uberon-4500009.description: (C): Fin spine that is part of a paired fin.

(C) uberon-2001788.description: (C): Dermal bone that is located near the lateral margin of the pelvic fin, and lateral to pelvic-fin lepidotrichium 1.

(C) uberon-2001789.description: (C): Dorsal-fin lepidotrichium 1 with co-ossified and unsegmented hemitrichia that form a stiff shaft and enlarged base that moveably articulates with first (anteriormost) dorsal-fin pterygiophore.

(C) uberon-2001790.description: (C): Dorsal-fin lepidotrichium 2 with co-ossified and unsegmented hemitrichia that form a stiff shaft and enlarged base that moveably articulates with second dorsal-fin pterygiophore.

(C) uberon-2001792.description: (C): Bony projection that is part of the pharyngobranchial 3.

(C) uberon-2001793.description: (C): Bony projection that is part of the pharyngobranchial 4.

(C) uberon-2001794.description: (C): Joint that articulates orbitosphenoid and prootic bones. Orbitosphenoid-prootic joint is paired.

(C) uberon-2001795.description: (C): Foramen in the anterior ceratohyal for passage of the hyoidean artery.

(C) uberon-2001796.description: (C): Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 2 bone.

(C) uberon-2001797.description: (C): Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 1 bone.

(C) uberon-2001798.description: (C): Intermuscular bone that articulates with the vertebral centrum.

(C) uberon-2001799.description: (C): Intracranial space formed by confluence of supraorbital, infraorbital, preopercular and temporal sensory canals. See also Di Dario (2004).

(C) uberon-2001800.description: (C): Modified epicentral intermuscular bone that connects the back of the skull with the pectoral girdle.

(C) uberon-2001801.description: (C): Joint that articulates quadrate and hyomandibula bones. Quadrate-hyomandibula joint is paired.

(C) uberon-2001804.description: (C): Foramen for the passage of the olfactory nerve or cranial nerve 1.

(C) uberon-2001805.description: (C): Endochondral bone that is located posterior to the dentary, medial to the angular and antero-dorsal to the retroarticular forming the lower jaw. The articular bears a dorso-posterior articular facet for the condyle of the quadrate. The articular is a paired bone.

(C) uberon-2001806.description: (C): An anterior extension of the swimbladder that passes through a foramen in the exoccipital; part of the otophysic connection between swimbladder and inner ear.

(C) uberon-2001807.description: (C): Fossa that is a concavity on the dorsolateral surface of the skull roof found at least partially on the epiotic (epioccipital).

(C) uberon-2001808.description: (C): Foramen through which cranial nerve VII (facial) exits.

(C) uberon-2001809.description: (C): Foramen through which cranial nerve V (trigeminal) exits.

(C) uberon-2001810.description: (C): Sensory canal anterior to and in close proximity to the otic and infraorbital sensory canals. The supraorbital sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

(C) uberon-2001811.description: (C): Sensory canal lateral or ventral to and in close proximity to the otic and supraorbital sensory canals at their union. The infraorbital sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the infraorbital bones.

(C) uberon-2001812.description: (C): Sensory canal lateral or ventral to and in close proximity to the otic and post-otic sensory canals at their union. The preoperculo-mandibular sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the preopercle, angular and dentary bones.

(C) uberon-2001813.description: (C): Sensory canal lateral or ventral to and in close proximity with the otic and post-otic sensory canals at their union, and anteroventrally with the mandibular sensory canal. The preopercular sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the preopercle bone.

(C) uberon-2001814.description: (C): Sensory canal anterior and ventral to and in close proximity with the preoperculo-mandibular sensory canal. The mandible sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the angular and dentary bones.

(C) uberon-2001815.description: (C): Dermal bone that is a bony expansion in the integument anterior to or flanking the dorsal fin that is part of and at the distal end of a supraneural or dorsal fin proximal radial.

(C) uberon-2002063.description: (C): Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one type of nuchal plate in an individual.

(C) uberon-2001816.description: (C): Nuchal plate that is unpaired and part of the supraneural and in contact, or not, with the supraoccipital crest anteriorly and middle nuchal plate posteriorly.

(C) uberon-2001817.description: (C): Nuchal plate that is unpaired and part of dorsal fin proximal radial 1 and usually in contact with the anterior nuchal plate and paired posterior nuchal plates.

(C) uberon-2001818.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2201818.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 1 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2001819.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2201819.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 2 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2001820.description: (C): Paired nuchal plate that is part of dorsal fin proximal radial 2 and usually in contact with the middle nuchal plate.

(C) uberon-2001821.description: (C): Portion of tissue that is part of the caudal fin.

(C) uberon-2001822.description: (C): Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 3 bone.

(C) uberon-2001823.description: (C): Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 4 bone.

(C) uberon-2001824.description: (C): Scale that is associated with the lateral line sensory canal.

(C) uberon-2002099.description: (C): Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one lateral line scale.

(C) uberon-2001825.description: (C): Process that is part of the urohyal; it is the posterolaterally directed process located on the ventrolateral margin of urohyal. Urohyal lateral process is paired.

(C) uberon-2001826.description: (C): Process that is part of the urohyal; it is the posterodorsally directed and median process located on the dorsal margin of the urohyal.

(C) uberon-2001827.description: (C): Ligament that connects the premaxilla to the maxilla.

(C) uberon-2001828.description: (C): Ligament that connects the maxilla with the lower jaw.

(C) uberon-2001829.description: (C): Caudal procurrent ray that forms part of the anterior dorsal series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin and may be associated with a neural spine or a epural or a uroneural. A pair of hemitrichia forms each ray.

(C) uberon-2001830.description: (C): Caudal procurrent ray that forms part of the anterior ventral series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin that may be associated with a neural spine or a epural or an uroneural (dorsal series) and with a hemal spine of a preural vertebra (ventral series). A caudal procurrent ray is an unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2001832.description: (C): Joint that articulates the parasphenoid and basioccipital. Parasphenoid-basioccipital joint is unpaired.

(C) uberon-2001833.description: (C): Tooth row that is on the premaxilla.

(C) uberon-2001840.description: (C): Anatomical point that is the apex of a projection or anything long and tapered; can be bony or cartilage.

(C) uberon-2001852.description: (C): Postcleithrum that anteriorly articulates with the supracleithrum and/or the cleithrum of the pectoral girdle; most dorsal element in a series of postcleithra.

(C) uberon-2001853.description: (C): Postcleithrum that articulates dorsally with postcleithrum 1, ventrally with postcleithrum 3, and anteriorly with cleithrum.

(C) uberon-2001854.description: (C): Postcleithrum that articulates dorsally with postcleithrum 2 and, sometimes, anteriorly with cleithrum.

(C) uberon-2001855.description: (C): Process on the dorso-posterior margin of the hyomandibula cartilage or bone that articulates with a depression on the antero-dorsal margin of the opercle.

(C) uberon-2001856.description: (C): Gill ray is a slender, usually rod-like cartilage within a gill filament and ligamentously tied to its associated pharyngeal arch bone or cartilage.

(C) uberon-2001857.description: (C): An artery that passes along the ventral portions of the hyoid arch; supplies oxygenated blood to the pseudobranch.

(C) uberon-2001858.description: (C): A pharyngobranchial bone that articulates with the neurocranium dorsally and epibranchial 1 and pharyngobranchial 2 ventrally; lies dorsal to other elements of the dorsal portions of the branchial arches.

(C) uberon-2001859.description: (C): Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 1 bone.

(C) uberon-2001867.description: (C): Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and at or posterior to the juncture of the bilaterally paired ceratobranchial 5 cartilage or bone.

(C) uberon-2001877.description: (C): Neural arch that is the anteriormost neural arch.

(C) uberon-2001878.description: (C): Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the second centrum.

(C) uberon-2001879.description: (C): Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the first centrum.

(C) uberon-2001880.description: (C): Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the third centrum.

(C) uberon-2001881.description: (C): Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the fourth centrum.

body: [parapophysis + rib of vertebra 3 + rib of vertebra 4](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_2001883)
(C) uberon-2001883.label_original: parapophysis + rib of vertebra 3 + rib of vertebra 4

(C) uberon-2001884.description: (C): Neural arch that is located posterior to the neurocranium and anterior to neural arch 1. The accessory neural arch is not associated with a vertebral centrum.

(C) uberon-2001885.description: (C): Neural spine that is associated with the first vertebra.

(C) uberon-2001886.description: (C): Neural spine that is associated with the second vertebra.

(C) uberon-2001887.description: (C): Neural spine that is associated with the third vertebra.

(C) uberon-2001888.description: (C): Supraneural bone located dorsal to vertebra 1.

(C) uberon-4300213.description: (C): Postcranial axial skeletal element located dorsal to vertebra 1.

(C) uberon-2001889.description: (C): Postcranial axial cartilage located dorsal to vertebra 1.

(C) uberon-2002103.description: (C): Anatomical cluster that consists of the ceratobranchial elements within an individual.

(C) uberon-2002102.description: (C): Anatomical cluster that consists of the epibranchial elements within an individual.

(C) uberon-2001914.description: (C): Endochondral element that is ventral, median, and associated with a single pharyngeal arch in the pharyngeal arch 3-7 skeleton.

(C) uberon-2001920.description: (C): Anatomical structure that is formed as a hiatus in the muscles covering the anterior chamber of the swim bladder in the area of ribs 5 and 6.

(C) uberon-2001921.description: (C): Surface structure that is a fleshy membrane covering part of the eye.

(C) uberon-2001922.description: (C): Joint between the left and right frontal bone.

(C) uberon-2001923.description: (C): Canal that houses the dorsal aorta.

(C) uberon-2001924.description: (C): Foramina that allow passage of occipital arteries.

(C) uberon-2001925.description: (C): Foramen for passage of nerve supplying otic lateral line.

(C) uberon-2001926.description: (C): Fossa or chamber on posterior portion of orbital region of neurocranium that serves as attachment site for posterior extrinsic eye muscles.

(C) uberon-2001927.description: (C): Fossa or chamber on anterior portion of orbital region of neurocranium that serves as attachment site for anterior extrinsic eye musculature.

(C) uberon-2001928.description: (C): Fossa of opercle that articulates with hyomandibular condyle for opercle.

(C) uberon-2001929.description: (C): Process of the epioccipital that extends posteriorly, is laminar in form and is usually attached to Weberian apparatus.

(C) uberon-2001930.description: (C): Dermal bone that is located lateral to vomer off midline of palate. Accessory vomerine tooth plate bears teeth and may be present as one or more pairs.

(C) uberon-2001931.description: (C): Scute that is an elongated plate associated with a ligament running between posterior nuchal plate and rib on vertebra 6. Infranuchal scute is paired and develops from its associated ligament and sensory canal tubular ossicle.

(C) uberon-2001932.description: (C): Dermal bone that is ring-shaped or cylindrical and surrounds a sensory canal.

(C) uberon-2001933.description: (C): Sensory canal that is a side branch between a sensory canal proximally and a pore at its distal end. Sensory canal tubule is bilaterally paired although often imperfectly so.

(C) uberon-2001934.description: (C): Dermal bone that is located on midline of snout in skin above mesethmoid and lateral ethmoid bones. Rostral plate bears type 1 odontodes and is unpaired.

(C) uberon-2001935.description: (C): Lip that is expanded to form a broad, rounded cup around the mouth.

(C) uberon-2001936.description: (C): Barbel that is attached to the anterior rim of the posterior nostril. Posterior nasal barbel is paired.

(C) uberon-4300287.description: (C): Barbel that is associated with a nostril. Nasal barbels are paired.

(C) uberon-2001937.description: (C): Barbel that is associated with the anterior nostril. Anterior nasal barbel is paired.

(C) uberon-2001938.description: (C): Barbel that is attached to the distal end of the maxilla and that originates on the side of the mouth. Maxillary barbel is paired.

(C) uberon-2001939.description: (C): Joint that articulates the left and right basipterygium cartilage or bone. Inter-basipterygium joint is unpaired.

(C) uberon-2001943.description: (C): Ligament that connects the metapterygoid to the autopalatine.

(C) uberon-2001944.description: (C): Lateral ethmoid-autopalatine ligament is a ligament that connects the lateral ethmoid to the autopalatine.

(C) uberon-2001945.description: (C): Mesethmoid-premaxillary ligament is a ligament that connects the mesethmoid to the premaxilla.

(C) uberon-2001946.description: (C): Mesethmoid-maxillary ligament is a ligament that connects the mesethmoid to the maxilla.

(C) uberon-2001947.description: (C): Joint that articulates the hyomandibular cartilage or bone and otic region cartilage or sphenotic bone, and often pterotic bone and prootic bone. Hyomandibular-otic region joint is paired.

(C) uberon-2001948.description: (C): Process that is part of the anal fin lepidotrichium.

(C) uberon-4300284.description: (C): Anatomical projection that is part of a fin.

(C) uberon-2001949.description: (C): Process that is part of the caudal fin lepidotrichium.

(C) uberon-2001951.description: (C): Surface structure that is a portion of skin that projects or hangs from the body.

(C) uberon-2001952.description: (C): Tooth row that is on the dentary.

(C) uberon-2001956.description: (C): Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the proximal end of epibranchial 1 bone, and that usually articulates with a pharyngobranchial element. Epibranchial 1 bone proximal cartilage is paired.

(C) uberon-2001957.description: (C): Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the proximal end of epibranchial 2 bone, and that usually articulates with a pharyngobranchial element. Epibranchial 2 bone proximal cartilage is paired.

(C) uberon-2001958.description: (C): Pharynbeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of ceratobranchial 3 bone, and that usually articulates with epibranchial 3 element. Ceratobranchial 3 bone distal cartilage is paired.

(C) uberon-4000003.description: (C): Chondrogenic element that is composed of cartilage that is not replaced.

(C) uberon-2001959.description: (C): Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the proximal end of ceratobranchial 4 bone, and that usually articulates with basibranchial 4 element. Ceratobranchial 4 proximal cartilage is paired.

(C) uberon-2001960.description: (C): Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of ceratobranchial 4 bone, and that usually articulates with epibranchial 4 element. Ceratobranchial 4 distal cartilage is paired.

(C) uberon-2001961.description: (C): Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of ceratobranchial 5 bone. Ceratobranchial 5 bone distal cartilage is paired.

(C) uberon-2001962.description: (C): Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of hypobranchial 1 bone, and that usually articulates with ceratobranchial 1 element. Hypobranchial 1 bone distal cartilage is paired.

(C) uberon-2001963.description: (C): Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of hypobranchial 2 bone, and that usually articulates with ceratobranchial 2 element. Hypobranchial 2 bone distal cartilage is paired.

(C) uberon-2001964.description: (C): Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of epibranchial bone 3 uncinate process. epibranchial bone 3 uncinate process cartilage is paired.

(C) uberon-2001965.description: (C): Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of epibranchial bone 4 uncinate process. Epibranchial bone 4 uncinate process cartilage is paired.

(C) uberon-2001968.description: (C): Mental barbel that originates on the chin, in a posterolateral position relative to the inner mental barbel.

(C) uberon-2002024.description: (C): Barbel that originates on the chin.

(C) uberon-2001969.description: (C): Mental barbel that originates on the chin, in an anteromedial position relative to the outer mental barbel. The inner mental barbel is nearer to the mandibular symphysis than is the outer mental barbel.

(C) uberon-2001971.description: (C): Parapophysis that is the lateral projection from the fourth centrum. Parapophysis 4 is bilaterally paired.

(C) uberon-2001972.description: (C): Ligament that connects one rib to another.

(C) uberon-2001976.description: (C): Anatomical cluster composed of one or more bones and tissue that separates the orbits.

(C) uberon-2001977.description: (C): Surface structure that is a portion of the integument thickened relative to surrounding area.

(C) uberon-2001980.description: (C): Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 5.

(C) uberon-2002055.description: (C): Joint between the centra, and sometimes the neural arches or parapophyses of vertebra 6 and vertebra 7.

(C) uberon-2001981.description: (C): Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 6.

(C) uberon-2001982.description: (C): Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 7.

(C) uberon-2001983.description: (C): Centrum that is part of vertebra 1.

(C) uberon-2001984.description: (C): Centrum that is part of vertebra 2.

(C) uberon-2001985.description: (C): Centrum that is part of vertebra 3.

(C) uberon-2001986.description: (C): Centrum that is part of vertebra 4.

(C) uberon-2001987.description: (C): Centrum that is part of vertebra 5.

(C) uberon-2001988.description: (C): Centrum that is part of vertebra 6.

(C) uberon-2001989.description: (C): Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is a spherical mass of cartilage located between the mandibular symphysis and ventral hyoid arch. Mandibular-hyoid median cartilage is unpaired.

(C) uberon-2001990.description: (C): Anatomical cluster that is an outgrowth of the soft tissue around the dorsolateral corner of a branchial arch that is internally supported by a core of rigid cartilage-like tissue. Epibranchial arborescent organ is paired.

(C) uberon-2001991.description: (C): Membrane bone extending between a transverse process of the second proximal dorsal-fin radial and the pleural rib of the sixth vertebra. Lateral bone is paired.

(C) uberon-2001992.description: (C): Anal fin lepidotrichium that is distally branched.

(C) uberon-2001993.description: (C): Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that is distally branched and segmented.

(C) uberon-2001994.description: (C): Anatomical cluster that consists of adjacent gill rakers constituting a row and is part of a ceratobranchial or epibranchial element of the branchial arches. Gill raker row is paired.

(C) uberon-2001997.description: (C): Compound dermal and endochondral bone that results from the fusion of the paired dermal parietal bones and the median endochondral supraoccipital. Forms the dorso-posterior element of the dermatocranium.

(C) uberon-2001998.description: (C): Dermal bone that results from the fusion of the dermal posttemporal and the dermal supracleithrum. Forms the upper skeletal element of the pectoral girdle between the cleithrum and neurocranium. Posttemporal-supracleithrum is paired.

(C) uberon-2001999.description: (C): Process arising from the posterior or postero-dorsal margin of the cleithrum dorsally adjacent to the insertion of the pectoral fin. Posterior cleithral process is paired.

(C) uberon-2002000.description: (C): Process that is tooth-like or thorn-like and arising from the posteriorly-facing margin of the abducted pectoral spine.
(C) uberon-2002000.label_original: posterior dentation of pectoral fin spine

(C) uberon-2002001.description: (C): Process that is tooth- or thorn-like and arising from the anteriorly-facing margin of the abducted pectoral spine. Anterior dentation of pectoral fin spine is usually present on the proximal and/or middle section of the pectoral fin spine.
(C) uberon-2002001.label_original: anterior dentation of pectoral fin spine

(C) uberon-2002002.description: (C): Process that is retrorse, thorn-like and arising from the anteriorly-facing margin of the abducted pectoral spine. Anterior distal serration of pectoral fin spine is usually present on the distal section of the pectoral fin spine.
(C) uberon-2002002.label_original: anterior distal serration of pectoral fin spine

(C) uberon-2002003.description: (C): Process that is tooth or thorn-like and arising from the posteriorly-facing margin of the abducted dorsal-fin spine 2.
(C) uberon-2002003.label_original: posterior dentation of dorsal fin spine 2

(C) uberon-2002004.description: (C): Process that is tooth- or thorn-like and arising from the anteriorly-facing margin of the abducted dorsal-fin spine 2.
(C) uberon-2002004.label_original: anterior dentation of dorsal fin spine 2

(C) uberon-2002005.description: (C): Dermal bone that is ventral to the preopercle and bears a portion of the preopercular sensory canal.

(C) uberon-2002006.description: (C): Pore that is located ventral to the posterior cleithral process and medial to the pectoral fin. Axillary pore is at the end of a duct from an integumentary gland.

(C) uberon-4300216.description: (C): Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 4.

(C) uberon-2002008.description: (C): Neural lamina is a median, vertical ridge or bony septum between neural spine 3 and neural spine 4 on the dorsal side of the Weberian vertebra. Neural lamina is unpaired.

(C) uberon-2002009.description: (C): Pharyngeal cartilage that caps the medial margin of the palatine at the autopalatine-lateral ethmoid joint.

(C) uberon-2002010.description: (C): Nerve that is a branch of cranial nerve VII that passes through or around the suspensorium to innervate muscles and sensory organs on or near pharyngeal arch 2.

(C) uberon-2002011.description: (C): Fontanel within the frontal bone near the frontal-sphenotic joint. Lateral fontanel of frontal is paired.

(C) uberon-2002012.description: (C): Foramen located on the dentary for passage of the mandibular nerve.

(C) uberon-2002013.description: (C): Process that is the dorsally directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 bone.

(C) uberon-2002014.description: (C): Process that is the dorsally directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 cartilage.

(C) uberon-2002016.description: (C): Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 4.

(C) uberon-2002017.description: (C): Process that is the anterior and medially directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 bone part of ceratobranchial 5 bone.

(C) uberon-2002018.description: (C): Process that is the anterior and medially directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 cartilage.

(C) uberon-2002019.description: (C): Bone that is a fusion of the pterotic, posttemporal, and supracleithrum bones.

(C) uberon-2002020.description: (C): Dermal bone bearing teeth located between the distal end of the premaxilla and the middle of the maxilla. The hypomaxilla is a paired bone.

(C) uberon-2002021.description: (C): Process that is the lateral projection of the parasphenoid arising and articulating with the more dorsal portions of the neurocranium, usually at the level of the prootic.

(C) uberon-2002022.description: (C): Dermal bone of the dorsal surface of the olfactory region. Dermethmoid can be paired or median.

(C) uberon-2002023.description: (C): Endochondral bone found between the preethmoid and maxilla.

(C) uberon-4300286.description: (C): Endochondral skeletal element found between the preethmoid and maxilla.

(C) uberon-4300285.description: (C): Cartilage element found between the preethmoid and maxilla.

(C) uberon-2002026.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2102026.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

(C) uberon-2202026.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial 1 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2002027.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2102027.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the second most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

(C) uberon-2202027.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial 2 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2002028.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2102028.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the third most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

(C) uberon-2202028.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial 3 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2002029.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial 4 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2102029.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the fourth most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

(C) uberon-2202029.description: (C): Pectoral fin proximal radial 4 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2002030.description: (C): Process on the ventral surface of the horizontal limb of the coracoid, close to and parallel to the coracoid-cleithrum joint. Ventral keel of coracoid is paired.

(C) uberon-2002031.description: (C): Foramen in the bone or cartilage comprising the anterior wall of the orbit, and through which passes at least the deep ophthalmic branch of cranial nerve V (trigeminal).

(C) uberon-2002034.description: (C): Joint that articulates the prootic and exoccipital. Prootic-exoccipital joint is paired.

(C) uberon-2002038.description: (C): Joint that articulates the basioccipital and exoccipital. Basioccipital-exoccipital joint is paired.

(C) uberon-2002039.description: (C): Fossa located on the neurocranium that is formed from portions of the sphenotic, frontal and pterotic bones.

(C) uberon-2002040.description: (C): Joint between the right and left coracoid bones of the pectoral girdle.

(C) uberon-2002041.description: (C): Parapophysis that is the lateral projection from the sixth centrum.

(C) uberon-2002042.description: (C): Parapophysis that is the lateral projection from the fifth centrum.

(C) uberon-2002043.description: (C): Process that arises and projects posterolaterally from parapophysis 4. Posterior limb of parapophysis 4 is bilaterally paired.

(C) uberon-2002044.description: (C): Process that arises and projects anterolaterally from parapophysis 4. Anterior limb of parapophysis 4 is bilaterally paired.

(C) uberon-2002049.description: (C): Epithelial cell that produces a chemical that triggers antipredator behavior.

(C) uberon-2002050.description: (C): Chemical substance that functions as an alarm signal.

(C) uberon-2002051.description: (C): Fine ridge on surface of scale, often parallel to the circumference of scale.

(C) uberon-2002052.description: (C): Shallow area that exists on the prootic.

(C) uberon-2002053.description: (C): Dermal bone that is located on or subjacent to the surface anywhere on the body and that is not part of the general complement of scales, dermal bone of the dermatocranium, postcranial axial skeleton or paired fin skeleton. Bony plate may exist singly, or as unpaired or paired clusters or series.

(C) uberon-2002096.description: (C): Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one bony plate in an individual.

(C) uberon-2002057.description: (C): Anatomical space that is the external opening of a gill slit connecting the pharyngeal cavity to the exterior. Gill opening is usually paired and located on the lateral or ventral surfaces of the head.

(C) uberon-2002058.description: (C): Centrum that is the fusion of centra 2-4.

(C) uberon-2002061.description: (C): Vertebra that is positioned between the vertebra immediately anterior to the first dorsal-fin pterygiophore to the anteriormost vertebra.

(C) uberon-2002062.description: (C): Caudal fin lepidotrichium that is distally branched.

(C) uberon-2002064.description: (C): Uroneural that is the anteriormost element of the uroneural series.

(C) uberon-2002065.description: (C): A vertebral centrum that is immediately posterior to preural vertebra 1. Ural centrum 1 is an unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2002163.description: (C): Ural vertebra that is located directly posterior to preural centrum 1. It may bear a rudimentary neural arch and sometimes a rudimentary spine or the neural arch and spine are completely absent and it may articulate or fuse with hypural 1 (polyural terminology). Ural vertebra 1 is an unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2002066.description: (C): Opening in the neurocranium to allow communication between the swimbladder and the inner ear.

(C) uberon-2002069.description: (C): Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal margin or tip of posterior process of basipterygium and projects posteriorly.
(C) uberon-2002069.label_original: distal cartilage of posterior process of basipterygium

(C) uberon-2002070.description: (C): Process that is bony and arises from anteromedial corner of basipterygium and projects anteriorly or anteromedially.

body: [distal cartilage of internal anterior process of basipterygium](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_2002071)
(C) uberon-2002071.description: (C): Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal tip of internal anterior process of basipterygium.
(C) uberon-2002071.label_original: distal cartilage of internal anterior process of basipterygium

(C) uberon-2002072.description: (C): Process that is bony and arises from anterior margin of basipterygium between internal anterior process of basipterygium and external anterior process of basipterygium. Middle anterior process of basipterygium projects anteriorly or anteromedially.

body: [distal cartilage of middle anterior process of basipterygium](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_2002073)
(C) uberon-2002073.description: (C): Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal tip of middle anterior process of basipterygium.
(C) uberon-2002073.label_original: distal cartilage of middle anterior process of basipterygium

(C) uberon-2002074.description: (C): Process that is bony and arises from anterolateral corner of basipterygium and projects anteriorly or anteromedially.

body: [distal cartilage of external anterior process of basipterygium](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_2002075)
(C) uberon-2002075.description: (C): Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal tip of external anterior process of basipterygium.
(C) uberon-2002075.label_original: distal cartilage of external anterior process of basipterygium

(C) uberon-2002076.description: (C): Process that is bony and arises from lateral margin of basipterygium lateral to pelvic fin lepidotrichium 1 and projects laterally or anterolaterally.

(C) uberon-2002077.description: (C): Bone that is attached or adjacent to lateral margin of basipterygium and anterior to pelvic fin lepidotrichium 1. The lateropterygium is a paired bone.

(C) uberon-2002078.description: (C): Perichondrally ossified bone that results from the fusion of two or more hypurals and support a variable number of principal caudal lepidotrichia. The hypural plate is an unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2002079.description: (C): Larval stage in some teleosts before metomorphosis.

(C) uberon-2002080.description: (C): Process that is a ventral projection from the supraoccipital that extends between the exoccipitals to the dorsal margin of the foramen magnum.

(C) uberon-2002167.description: (C): Modified neural arch, probably of ural centrum 4, formed by a bony base that may extend along the dorso-lateral surfaces of ural centra and preural centra 1 or 2 and by a well-developed antero-dorsal membranous projection that extends lateral to the base of epural(s) and anterior toward the neural arches and/or spines of preural centra 1 or 2 (Arratia and Schultze, 1992). The stegural is a paired bone.

(C) uberon-2002082.description: (C): Fulcrum that is large, laterally expanded, paired or unpaired, scale-like, and that precedes the base of a fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

(C) uberon-2002291.description: (C): Dermal bone that is typically associated with a fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

(C) uberon-2002083.description: (C): Fulcrum that is a small, paired dermal structure associated with the marginal, leading rays of paired and/or unpaired fins. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

(C) uberon-2002084.description: (C): Postero-dorsal process of preural vertebra 1 or postero-dorsal process of the compound terminal centrum. The pleurostyle is a paired membrane bone.

(C) uberon-2002086.description: (C): Anatomical cluster consisting of only a bony element or a combination of a bony element and one or more scales, or only modified scales, which lies in a fin fold at the base of the uppermost ray.

(C) uberon-2002087.description: (C): Pectoral axillary process is an elongate structure formed by one or more additional postcleithra or modified scales or a combination of both, that is firmly attached to a skin fold above the articular condyle of the uppermost pectoral fin ray or lepidotrichium 1.

(C) uberon-2002088.description: (C): A small bone articulating distally with the haemal arch or a short haemal spine.

(C) uberon-2002089.description: (C): Dermal bone located on the ventral surface of the skull and positioned between the two rami of the lower jaw. Anteriorly the gular attaches to the symphysis of the lower jaw through fibrous connective tissue. The gular is an unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2002092.description: (C): Median chondrified cartilage bound to premaxillary ascending process by a rostro-premaxilla ligament.

(C) uberon-2002094.description: (C): Dorsal fin pterygiophore that is the anteriormost pterygiophore of the dorsal fin.

(C) uberon-2002095.description: (C): A third opening of the posttemporal fossa posteriorly located relative to the fossa. It is bordered completely by the epiocciptial, or by both the epioccipital and exoccipital.

(C) uberon-2002097.description: (C): Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one sensory canal pore.

(C) uberon-2002105.description: (C): Anatomical structure located in the hindbrain that receives primary electroreceptor input.

(C) uberon-2002106.description: (C): Anatomical structure that is a subdivision of the cerebellum; it is the location of some lateral line nerve synapses.

(C) uberon-2002107.description: (C): Anatomical structure that consists of two neuron types: pacemaker cells and relay cells. The medullary command nucleus commands the timing of the electric organ discharge.

(C) uberon-2002108.description: (C): Papilla that is part of the mouth.

(C) uberon-2002114.description: (C): Multi-tissue structure that is a transient outgrowth of tissue on skin brooding fish that acts as an attachment site for embryos.

(C) uberon-2002117.description: (C): Organ that functions in egg deposition.

(C) uberon-2002118.description: (C): Erosion channel that radiates out from the growth center (focus) of the scale across and through the circuli.

(C) uberon-2002122.description: (C): Scale that forms part of the posterior border of the caudal-fin organ. Pouch scales are usually hypertrophied.

(C) uberon-2002125.description: (C): Organ that consists of a pouch located on the ventral caudal-fin lobe, opening posteriorly, and composed of glandular tissue. The caudal-fin organ presumably functions to secrete pheromones during courtship.

(C) uberon-2002124.description: (C): Surface structure that is a small protuberance on the surface of the body. Nuptial tubercles primarily function to facilitate contact between individuals for breeding.

(C) uberon-2002126.description: (C): Anatomical cluster that consists of thickened caudal-fin rays modified into a pumping mechanism associated with the caudal-fin organ.

(C) uberon-2002127.description: (C): Intermuscular bone that is located in the dorsal and ventral forward flexures of the myoseptum.

(C) uberon-2002129.description: (C): Multi-tissue structure that is a cartilaginous or collagenous bar supporting the caudal appendage.

(C) uberon-2002130.description: (C): Multi-tissue structure that is region of the body posterior to the last anal-fin ray.

(C) uberon-2002131.description: (C): Anatomical structure that consists of a sheet of connective tissue attached to the vertebral column and dividing the epaxial and hypaxial musculature.

(C) uberon-2002133.description: (C): Surface structure that is a midsaggital strap of flattened ectodermal tissue extending along the posterodorsal midline.

(C) uberon-2002141.description: (C): Ligament that is in the eye and is located at the angle between the cornea and the iris.

(C) uberon-2002144.description: (C): CNS white matter, an axonal tract between ventral diencephalon and ventral telencephalon. At 3 d, the anterior catecholaminergic tract includes noradrenergic projections from the hindbrain and dopaminergic projections from ventral dopaminergic neurons. During later development, other catecholaminergic projections may also contribute to the anterior catecholaminergic tract.

(C) uberon-2002145.description: (C): Portion of tissue that forms from the swim bladder epithelium at the anterior end of the swim bladder.

(C) uberon-2002149.description: (C): Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 8.

(C) uberon-2002150.description: (C): Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 9.

(C) uberon-2002151.description: (C): Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 10.

(C) uberon-2002152.description: (C): Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 11. May have hemal arch and rib.

(C) uberon-2002154.description: (C): Anatomical space which is located beneath the operculum and external to the gills.

(C) uberon-2002158.description: (C): Compound endochdondral and dermal bone that results from the fusion of the dermal dermopalatine and the endochondral autopalatine and forms the antero-lateral region of the palate. Commonly, it articulates with the maxilla antero-laterally and with the ethmoidal region medially. The palatine is paired.

(C) uberon-2002159.description: (C): Basal fulcrum that precedes a caudal fin lobe. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

(C) uberon-2002160.description: (C): A vertebral centrum that is located immediately posterior to ural centrum 2 (polyural terminology). Ural centrum 3 articulates with hypural 3 ventrally. Ural centrum 3 is an unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2002161.description: (C): A vertebral centrum that is located immediately posterior to ural centrum 3 (polyural terminology) and may fuse to ural centrum 3 early in ontogeny. Ural centrum 4 articulates with hypural 4 ventrally. Ural centrum 4 is an unpaired median bone.

(C) uberon-2002165.description: (C): An anatomical cluster of short rays, shorter than the principal ones, which form the anterior dorsal and ventral series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin that may be associated with neural spines, epurals and uroneurals (dorsal series) and haemal spines of preural vertebrae (ventral series) (Arratia, 2008). The anteriormost procurrent rays are commonly unsegmented, but the posteriormost ones are usually segmented. The procurrent rays are numbered from caudal to rostral direction. The caudal procurrent ray series is an unpaired median series.

(C) uberon-2002166.description: (C): An elongate lateral process ventrally placed to the proximal region of the pleurostyle. The pseudourostyle is paired.

(C) uberon-2002168.description: (C): Urostyle that is the result of fusion of preural centrum 1 with ural centra 1 and 2.
(C) uberon-2002168.label_original: preural centrum 1 + ural centrum 1 + ural centrum 2

(C) uberon-2002174.description: (C): Hindbrain nucleus which consists of cell bodies whose axons exit the hindbrain via cranial nerve VIII and innervate hair cells of the lateral line and inner ear. The neurons of these nuclei are unusual in that they extend both contra- and ipsilateral dendrites.

(C) uberon-2002179.description: (C): Telencephalic nucleus which has migrated away from the ependyma and consists of the central, lateral nuclei and the dorsal and ventral entopeduncular nuclei. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.
(C) uberon-2002179.label_original: obsolete peripheral nucleus of ventral telencephalon

(C) uberon-2002180.description: (C): Peripheral nucleus of the ventral telencephalon which is located immediately lateral to the dorsal nucleus of the ventral telencephalon. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.
(C) uberon-2002180.label_original: obsolete central nucleus of ventral telencephalon

(C) uberon-2002185.description: (C): Portion of tissue that consists of afferent axons from the inferior olive and synapsing with Purkinje cells within the molecular layer of the valvula cerebelli and corpus cerebelli.

(C) uberon-2002192.description: (C): Motor nucleus of vagal nerve that is located within the dorsolateral portion of rhomobomere 8.
(C) uberon-2002192.label_original: dorsolateral motor nucleus of vagal nerve

(C) uberon-2002193.description: (C): Portion of tissue that grows in from the dorsolateral wall of the otic vesicle, forming a dorsolateral partition between the developing anterior and posterior semicircular canals.

(C) uberon-2002195.description: (C): Portion of tissue that is a thickening and reshaping of the epidermal basal stratum cells beneath which fibroblasts accumulate to form the scale primordium.

(C) uberon-2002198.description: (C): Muscle which is part of the head.

(C) uberon-2002199.description: (C): CNS white matter that crosses the midline within the hindbrain.

(C) uberon-2002202.description: (C): Diencephalic nucleus which is located between the dorsal hypothalamus and the caudal tuberal nucleus and does not contain tyrosine hydroxylase immunoreactive cells.

(C) uberon-2002204.description: (C): Peripheral nucleus of the ventral telencephalon that has migrated to the periphery of the brain. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.
(C) uberon-2002204.label_original: obsolete lateral nucleus of ventral telencephalon

(C) uberon-2002207.label_original: medial motor nucleus of vagal nerve

(C) uberon-2002208.description: (C): Podocyte that is part of the kidney (mesonephros).

(C) uberon-2002213.description: (C): Portion of cranial nerve II where large fasicles of axons from the optic fiber layer come together prior to leaving the eye.

(C) uberon-2002222.label_original: obsolete periventricular nucleus of ventral telencephalon

(C) uberon-2002232.label_original: presumptive cardiac ventricle primitive heart tube

(C) uberon-2002237.description: (C): Podocyte that is part of the pronephros.

(C) uberon-2002248.description: (C): Lateral line canal that that crosses the supratemporal region posterior to the openings of the endolymphatic ducts and connects the lateral canals of each side.

(C) uberon-2002255.description: (C): Organism subdivision that is the side of the body possessing eyes.

(C) uberon-2002256.description: (C): Organism subdivision that is the side of the body lacking eyes.

(C) uberon-4200070.description: (C): Fin spine that is part of a median fin.

(C) uberon-2002269.description: (C): Pharyngeal arch cartilage located between uncinate process of epibranchial 1 and pharyngobranchial 2.

(C) uberon-2002274.description: (C): Ctenoid scale with two or three alternating rows of cteni marginally and truncated cteni submarginally. (Roberts 1993).

(C) uberon-2002275.description: (C): Neuromast of the supraorbital sensory canal in the nasal bone. It is innervated by the buccal nerve rather than by the supraorbital nerve, which invariably innervates neuromasts of the supraorbital canal. (Johnson and Patterson 1993).

(C) uberon-2002276.description: (C): Fin that is an unpaired fin located in the sagittal plane of the organism.

(C) uberon-2002277.description: (C): Pectoral fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2202277.description: (C): Pectoral fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2002279.description: (C): Pectoral fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2202279.description: (C): Pectoral fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2002280.description: (C): Pectoral fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2202280.description: (C): Pectoral fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2002285.description: (C): Scale that is smooth-edged, round or oval and composed of acellular dermal bone lacking small spines on the posterior exposed edge. (from http://www.briancoad.com/Dictionary/introduction.htm).

(C) uberon-2002288.description: (C): Clear ocular fluid in the anterior segment of the eye. It is produced primarily by dorsal ciliary epithelial cells.

(C) uberon-2002289.description: (C): Multi-tissue structure that composes the opaque fibrous outer layer of the eye.

(C) uberon-2002290.description: (C): Portion of organism substance that is a gelatinous extracellular matrix structure that fills the vitreous cavity of the eye.
