(C) uberon-2002292.description: (C): Basal fulcrum that is positioned at the dorsal or anterodorsal margin of the caudal fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

(C) uberon-2002293.description: (C): Basal fulcrum that is positioned at the anteroventral margin of the caudal fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

(C) uberon-2005010.description: (C): The mesencephalic veins (MsV) enter the mid cerebral veins (MCeV) at the dorsal midline. THe MCeVs originate at the dorsal midline, proceede lateraly in a ventral direction to drain into the paired primordial midbrain channels (PHBC). ogai et al. 2001., Kimmel et al. 1993.

(C) uberon-2005011.description: (C): A vascular loop attached to the efferent part of the mandibular arch that forms at 3.5 dpf. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005013.description: (C): The branch of the afferent branchial artery that continues posteriodorsally. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005014.description: (C): The anterioventral proceeding branch of the afferent branchial artery. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005017.description: (C): The vessel between the anterior cerebral vein and the mid cerebral vein. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005020.description: (C): Arteries that irrigate the forebrain and midbrain Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005021.description: (C): Extend upward from the PCS, branch to provide an arterial feed to the hindbrain, then drain back down into the PHBC Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005022.description: (C): The opercular artery arises from the hyoid stump on the first aortic arch, then follows the lateral margin of the operculum (gill covering) ventrally to reconnect into the proximal part of the first aortic arch. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005025.description: (C): Trunk vessel that connects to the primitive hindbrain channel and the basilar artery at the caudal end of the medulla oblongata. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005026.description: (C): Main route for venous drainage of the anterior and mid cerebral veins as well as portions of the primordial hindbrain channel. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005029.description: (C): Hematopoietic tissue derived from the cephalic mesoderm. Predominantly produces myeloid cells. de Jong and Zon 2005.

(C) uberon-2005031.description: (C): Vessel that connects to the primitive hindbrain channel and the basilar artery at the caudal end of the medulla oblongata. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005032.description: (C): Vein that connects to the hyaloid vein that drains the eye. External to eye. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005034.description: (C): Vessels run longitudinally along the horizontal myoseptum. These vessels are not functional until after lumenization which occurs near 4 dpf. Isogai et al. 2003.

(C) uberon-2005036.description: (C): A continuation of the anterior mesenteric artery, which branches out from the dorsal aorta just caudal to the pronephric glomus. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005044.description: (C): The artery that carries blood to the eye. It branches from the internal carotid artery and enters the eye ventrally through the optic fissure. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005048.description: (C): Vessel that branches from cranial division of the internal carotid artery, extending laterally around the rostral end of the head. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005049.description: (C): After the primitive prosencephalic artery forms it becomes disconnected from the cranial division of the internal carotid artery and instead it connects to the anterior mesencephalic central artery and the communicating vessels of the palatocerebral artery.

(C) uberon-2005050.description: (C): The PLA branches ventrally from the CrDI. It extends rostrally along the base of mid- and forebrain, then loops medially and links to the corresponding vessel from the other side of the embryo. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005051.description: (C): Connect the palatocerebral artery with the prosencephalic artery. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005052.description: (C): Arteries that irrigate rostral regions of the midbrain. They extend between the Basial communicating artery to the anterior cerebral vein. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005055.description: (C): Drains the PLA loop proceeds straight caudally along the cranial midline just above the pharynx, just below the diencephalon. Forms a 'T' with the palatocerebral veins. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005056.description: (C): Vein that drains the median palatocerebral vein into the optic vein. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005066.description: (C): Composed of scattered layers of interrupted elastic lamina. Hu et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005067.description: (C): Composed of 7-10 layers of helically arranged smooth muscle cells surrounded by a fine network of collagen, reticular, and elastic fibrils. Hu et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005068.description: (C): Composed of subendothelium with longitudinally oriented collagen, reticular fibrils, elastic fibers, and smooth muscle cells bound by a thin endothelial layer. Hu et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005074.description: (C): Cardiac conduction system, characterized by slow impulse propagation and prolonged refractory periods.

(C) uberon-2005075.description: (C): Portion of the cardiac conduction system, with rapid impulse propagation.

(C) uberon-2005078.description: (C): Project rostrally and dorsally from the AMCtA to to irrigate the midportion of the midbrain Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005079.description: (C): Project dorsally from BCA to irrigate the caudal part of midbrain Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005080.description: (C): Unpaired artery departing from dorsal aorta, typically supplying the small intestine.

(C) uberon-2005084.description: (C): These arteies branch dorsally from both sides of the posterior communicating artery looping up to join with the opposite MtA as well as with both middle cerebral veins at the dorsal midline of the head. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005085.description: (C): The nasal arteries start at the internal carotid artey and travel rostrally, passing along the right and left walls of the nasal sac at the most rostral end of the head. From the nasal sac, the NA flows into the nasal veins. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005088.description: (C): Unpaired artery departing from dorsal aorta that typically supplies the large intestine.

(C) uberon-2005089.description: (C): An elaborate set of vessels that branche off caudally from the anterior mesenteric artery just after the dorsal aorta. The SBA vascular loops are located on the ventral side of the swim bladder. Isogai et al. 2001.

(C) uberon-2005098.description: (C): Positioned in the intraray mesenchym between the hemirays of the lepidotrichia,. Huang et al. 2003.

(C) uberon-2005099.description: (C): Lie flanking and just lateral to the fin ray, in the interray mesenchyme. Huang et al. 2003.

(C) uberon-2005100.description: (C): Vessels that travel between artery and veins or vein and vein in a single ray.

(C) uberon-2005101.description: (C): Vessels that travel between veins in adjacent rays.

(C) uberon-2005113.description: (C): Neuromast that is part of the dorsal lateral line. Kimmel et al, 1995. (Also see Anatomical Atlas entry for lateral line by T. Whitfield.).

(C) uberon-2005115.description: (C): Primordium that forms the first neuromasts of the posterior lateral line. This primordium travels at 1.5-1.7 somites/hour and deposits neuromast that are polarized along the antero-posterior axis.

(C) uberon-2005116.description: (C): Second lateral line primordium. These primordia moves at 0.2 somites/hour and deposite neromasts that are polarized in a dorso-ventral direction.

(C) uberon-2005118.description: (C): A migrating group of cells originating from the middle lateral line placode. The primordium deposits neuromasts with interneuromasts between them.

(C) uberon-2005126.description: (C): Intestinal epithelium which lines the lumen of the intestinal bulb.

(C) uberon-2005135.description: (C): Epithelium that surrounds a primary tooth. This epithelium is committed to formation of replacement teeth.

(C) uberon-2005142.description: (C): Skeletal tissue that is hypermineralized and aprismatic and deposited by a combination of ameloblasts and odontoblasts that are excluded from the matrix. Enameloid develops from pre-enameloid tissue.

(C) uberon-2005144.description: (C): A branch of the 8th cranial nerve that innervates the cristae ampullaris.

(C) uberon-2005149.description: (C): Part of regeneration epithelium at the tip of the fin/limb [ZFA,modified].
(C) uberon-2005149.label_original: distal epidermal cap of regenerating fin/limb

(C) uberon-2005150.description: (C): Layer of the wound epidermis that surrounds the blastema in the fin or limb[ZFA,modified].
(C) uberon-2005150.label_original: basal regeneration epithelium of regenerating fin/limb

(C) uberon-2005151.description: (C): Iridescent iridophore containing gold reflecting platelets.

(C) uberon-2005152.description: (C): Iridescent iridophore containing silver reflecting platelets.

(C) uberon-2005170.description: (C): Bile duct that collects from the intrahepatic ducts and feeds into the common bile duct.

(C) uberon-2005174.description: (C): Portion of the liver which develops on the fish's ventral side.

(C) uberon-2005175.description: (C): An interneuron in the spinal cord. CoPA are bipolar with 'T' shaped dorsal dendrites, have contralateral longitudinal axons that crosses the cord dorsal to the Mauthner neuron and ascends in the dorsal cord.

(C) uberon-2005176.description: (C): An interneuron of the spinal cord. CoSA, have contralateral longitudinal axons that crosses the cord dorsal to the Mauthner neuron and ascends in the dorsal cord.

(C) uberon-2005186.description: (C): A bifurcate interneuron. It is a commissural neuron with both ascending and descending axons in the ventrolateral cord contralateral to its cell body.

(C) uberon-2005210.description: (C): CNS interneurons located in the midbrain.

(C) uberon-2005217.description: (C): Hindbrain interneuron that is part of rhombomere 7, with 2 ventral neurons in each hemi-rhombomere.

(C) uberon-2005219.description: (C): Cranial vasculature where the posterior cerebral veins and the trans-choroid plexus branch form a circuit around the 4th ventricle choroid plexus.

(C) uberon-2005226.description: (C): Median fin proximal radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005228.description: (C): Lepidotrichium that is articulated or segmented, and that can be simple or branched.

(C) uberon-2005230.description: (C): A bifurcate interneuron where the axon projects ventrally, crossing the spinal cord ventral to the Mauthner axons before bifurcating and extending dorsally.

(C) uberon-2005233.description: (C): An interneuron of the spinal cord with an ipsilateral axon that extends ventral to the Mauthner axon then turns dorsally and caudally and sometimes has a minor ascending branch.

(C) uberon-2005234.description: (C): A spinal interneuron with a dorsal dendrite that extends caudally. CoLA also has midlateral process that extend rostrally and caudally, the axon crosses the cord dorsal to the Mauthner cell and ascends, extending dorsally. Axon has minor descending branch.

(C) uberon-2005240.description: (C): Kolmer-Agduhr neurons are ciliated GABAergic neurons that contact the central canal of the spinal cord and have ipsilateral ascending axons.

(C) uberon-2005245.description: (C): Fibrous joint connecting the parietal bones.

(C) uberon-2005246.description: (C): Is a fibroblast that differentiates from the de-differentiated cells of the blastema.

(C) uberon-2005247.description: (C): Interneurons of the spinal cord that arise from the V1 proliferation domain. The CiA neurons inhibit motoneurons, other ventral interneurons and also inhibit dorsal sensory neurons involved in sensory gating,. CiA have ipsilateral axonal projections in both motor and sensory regions of spinal cord.

(C) uberon-2005259.description: (C): Capillary that has endothelial cells that provide an uninterrupted lining, and only allow small molecules, like water and ions to diffuse through tight junctions which leave gaps of unjoined membrane which are called intercellular clefts.

(C) uberon-2005266.description: (C): Fossa on the pterotic where the hyomandibula articulates.

(C) uberon-2005269.description: (C): Space enclosed by the trabeculae cranii. The anterior tip of the notochord extends into the posterior region of the hypophyseal fenestra.

(C) uberon-2005272.description: (C): Immature reproductive tissue that has not undergone final maturation into either testis or ovary. During gonadal development, the gonad may be transiently intersexual where there is a parallel presence of both oocytes and spermatocytes.

(C) uberon-2005273.description: (C): A thin layer of smooth muscle immediately beneath the base of the villi which permits the intestinal mucosa to dynamically move and fold.

(C) uberon-2005275.description: (C): Foramen in the hyomandibula that allows passage of the anterior lateral line nerve and the facial nerve (cranial nerve VII).

(C) uberon-2005279.description: (C): Smooth muscle of the enteric muscle system in which the cells are aligned perpendicular to the lumen of the gut.

(C) uberon-2005292.description: (C): Portion of the renal tubule which is just posterior to the distal early tubule.

(C) uberon-2005311.description: (C): Simple squamous epithelium that lines the capsule of the pronephric glomerulus.

(C) uberon-2005316.description: (C): Fin fold of the pectoral fin bud, resulting from mesenchyme migration into the apical fold.

(C) uberon-2005317.description: (C): The functional webs of the paired fins. They arise as a consequence of apical fold (AER) expansion and of migration of the distal mesenchyme. The fin folds are delimited by a dorsal and a ventral striated epidermis. The cells of the epidermal basal stratum are positioned on a basement membrane. Directly beneath the basement membrane of each side there is an array of actinotrichs, fibers of the extracellular matrix which act as supportive elements of the larval fin folds.

(C) uberon-2005325.description: (C): Ionocyte located in the integument during embryonic and larval stages.

(C) uberon-2005327.description: (C): Integument ionocyte rich in vacuolar-type H+ ATPase and carbonic anhydrase.

(C) uberon-2005338.description: (C): Posterior protrusion of the third ventricle.

(C) uberon-2005343.description: (C): CNS white matter, axonal tract interconnecting catecholaminergic cell groups in the posterior tuberculum and hypothalamus.

(C) uberon-2005346.description: (C): Portion of the pancreatic duct, external to the pancreas body that connects the pancreas with the hepatopancreatic ampulla.

(C) uberon-2005372.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005373.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005374.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005375.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 4 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005376.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 5 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005377.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 6 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005378.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 7 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005379.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 8 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005380.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005381.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 4 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005382.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 5 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005383.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 6 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005384.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 7 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005385.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 8 element that is composed of bone tissue.

(C) uberon-2005409.description: (C): The dorsal part of the ear. Comprises the three semicircular canals, which connect to the utricle.

(C) uberon-2005410.description: (C): The ventral portion of the ear. It contains the saccule and the laguena which are the primary auditory organs.

(C) uberon-2005412.description: (C): Duct that crosses the midline connecting the sacculi.

(C) uberon-2007001.description: (C): Early-forming telencephalic neural cluster. Neurons of the dorso-rostral cluster (drc) extend axons to form the supra-optic tract (SOT) and the anterior commissure (AC). Ross et al., 1992.

(C) uberon-2007002.description: (C): Early-forming neural cluster located in the rostral diencephalon. At 19 h, axons arising from the vrc grow caudally to pioneer the tract of the postoptic commissure (TPOC). Ross et al., 1992.

(C) uberon-2007003.description: (C): Early-forming neural cluster of the ventral midbrain. At 16 h, axons of the vcc grow caudally to pioneer the medial longitudinal fasciculus (MLF), which is part of the larger ventral longitudinal tract (VLT). Later, neurons from this cluster project axons rostrally into the tract of the post-optic commissure (TPOC). Ross et al., 1992.

(C) uberon-2007004.description: (C): Early-developing neuronal cluster of the epiphysis. By 24 hpf the pioneer axon of the dorsoventral diencephalic tract (DVDT) has arisen from the ec and grown ventrally. As this axon encounters axons of the TPOC, it makes a near-90 rostral turn and grows rostrally among axons of the TPOC growing in the opposite direction. Ross et al., 1992.

(C) uberon-2007010.description: (C): Part of the forebrain that is ventral to the ventral thalamus and dorsal to the preoptic area. See page 44 of the Atlas of Early Zebrafish Brain Development.

(C) uberon-2007052.description: (C): Is a hyoid muscle that inserts at the most anterior basibranchial and also at the posterior ends of the ceratohyals and functions in jaw closure.

(C) uberon-2007053.description: (C): Is a hyoid muscle that attaches to the dorsomedial faces of the hyosymplectics.

(C) uberon-2007054.label_original: pillar of the anterior semicircular canal

(C) uberon-2007055.label_original: pillar of the lateral semicircular canal

(C) uberon-2200508.description: (C): Pelvic fin radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2200623.description: (C): Basipterygium element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205225.description: (C): Median fin radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205226.description: (C): Median fin proximal radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205372.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205373.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205374.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205375.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 4 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205376.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 5 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205377.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 6 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205378.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 7 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205379.description: (C): Dorsal fin distal radial 8 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205380.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 3 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205381.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 4 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205382.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 5 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205383.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 6 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205384.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 7 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-2205385.description: (C): Dorsal fin proximal radial 8 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

(C) uberon-3000002.description: (C): Paired, cup-shaped cartilage that are dorsal to the septomaxillae and anterior to the oblique cartilage. The anterior, convex face of each alary cartilage is synchondrotically fused to the superior prenasal cartilage and the ventral edge is fused to the superior margin of the crista intermedia.

(C) uberon-3000003.description: (C): Dorsal process that extends toward the nasal bone. The posterior (inner) face of each alary process is concave and is invested dorsomedially by the superior prenasal cartilage and ventromedially by the inferior prenasal cartilage.

(C) uberon-3000006.description: (C): Foramen for the R. alveolaris of Nerve VII and the alveolar artery.

(C) uberon-3000012.description: (C): Point of insertion of the adductor mandibulae musculature.

(C) uberon-3000015.description: (C): Process that extends anteriorly from the planum triangulare and invests the medial face of the pars facialis of the maxilla.

(C) uberon-3000016.description: (C): Paired, vertical, and relatively straight plates that form the anterior limit of the nasal capsule.

(C) uberon-3000017.label_original: anterior process of pars palatina of maxilla

(C) uberon-3000018.description: (C): In a triradiate pterygoid, the process that extends anteriorly towards the maxilla.

(C) uberon-3000036.description: (C): Process that extends medially from the ventromedial corner of the palatoquadrate cartilage and articulates or fuses to the anterior wall of the otic capsule via the basitrabecular process.

(C) uberon-3000041.description: (C): Anatomical structure which forms from an enlargement of the anterior portion of each gonad in all male bufonid larvae and consists of ovarian tissues.

(C) uberon-3000044.description: (C): Undifferentiated cell that is produced by early cleavages of the fertilized egg (zygote).

(C) uberon-3000050.description: (C): The part of the skull that encloses the brain and surrounds the inner ear.

(C) uberon-3000059.description: (C): Narrow process of the skeletal support that projects forward.

(C) uberon-3000061.label_original: obsolete cartilage bridge of nasal skeleton

(C) uberon-3000068.description: (C): Lateral cartilaginous border of the fenestra endochoanalis.

(C) uberon-3000074.description: (C): Lateral wall of chondrocranial braincase between lamina orbitonasalis and pila metoptica.

(C) uberon-3000085.description: (C): Accessory cavity located ventral to the cavum principale and cavum medius.

(C) uberon-3000087.description: (C): Small accessory cavity located between the cavum principale and cavum inferius.

(C) uberon-3000089.description: (C): The largest part of the nasal cavity, containing the olfactory epithelium.

(C) uberon-3000101.description: (C): Anterior-lateral projections from the corpus of the hyoid apparatus.

(C) uberon-3000110.description: (C): Thin, horizontal ridge that extends medially from the corpus of the septomaxilla; it lays on the lamina inferior.

(C) uberon-3000113.description: (C): Paired, oblique plates of cartilage located ventral to the alary cartilages. The dorsomedial margin of each crista intermedia is fused to the transitional zone between the septum nasi and the tectum nasi, whereas the ventrolateral margin bears two laminae, the lamina superior and the lamina inferior.

(C) uberon-3000117.description: (C): Ventral crest of the paries nasi.

(C) uberon-3000118.description: (C): Short and blunt process that extends posteriorly from the posteromedial margin of the postnasal wall, on the anterodorsal corner of the orbit above the medial orbitonasal foramen.

(C) uberon-3000121.description: (C): Also known as fibrous connective tissue. Forms ligaments and tendons and is characterized by densely packed collagen fibers that have great tensile strength.

(C) uberon-3000131.description: (C): Flange that extends ventrally from about the middle portion of the margo mandibularis.

(C) uberon-3000155.description: (C): Large anterior outgrowth of the septomaxilla that is directed into the space between the alary cartilage and the lamina inferior.

(C) uberon-3000161.description: (C): Opening on the ventral aspect of the nasal capsule. It contains the apertura nasalis interna.

(C) uberon-3000162.description: (C): Opening on the anterolateral aspect of the nasal capsule. It contains the apertura nasalis externa.

(C) uberon-3000164.description: (C): Opening on the lateral side of the nasal capsule.

(C) uberon-3000166.description: (C): Small opening at the anterior tip of the nasal capsule, on the floor of the cavum inferius. It is located medially to the base of the inferior prenasal cartilage and serves for the passage of the ramus medialis narium and arteria orbitonasalis.

(C) uberon-3000167.description: (C): Elongated opening located on the lateral side of the nasal capsule.

(C) uberon-3000171.description: (C): Large opening of the nasal floor anterior to the fenestra endochoanalis.

(C) uberon-3000178.description: (C): Independent, horizontal bar of cartilage located on the anterior part of the fenestra ovalis in front of the pars interna plectri.

(C) uberon-3000226.description: (C): Complex formed by two units, the hyoid and laryngeal apparatuses, which are both derived from the larval hyobranchial skeleton.

(C) uberon-3000234.description: (C): Elongate cartilage that extends anteroventrally from the solum nasi to abut the ventral portion of the posterior aspect of the alary process of the premaxilla. It was first described by Wiedersheim in 1876.

(C) uberon-3000259.description: (C): Lateral expansion of the crista intermedia that serves as the floor of the cavum medium.

(C) uberon-3000260.description: (C): Free, dorsal margin of the lamina inferior.

(C) uberon-3000264.description: (C): Lateral expansion of the crista intermedia that serves as the roof of the cavum medium.

(C) uberon-3000265.description: (C): Anatomical structure that is part of the larva.

(C) uberon-3000280.description: (C): Ventrally directed margin that connects the anterior and posterior rami of the pterygoid.

(C) uberon-3000281.description: (C): Dorsal margin of the maxilla between the frontal and zygomatico-maxillary processes.

(C) uberon-3000282.description: (C): Margin that connects the anterior and medial rami of the pterygoid.

(C) uberon-3000283.description: (C): Anterior margin of the squamosal that takes part in the formation of the orbit.

(C) uberon-3000284.description: (C): Margin that connects the posterior and medial rami of the pterygoid.

(C) uberon-3000288.description: (C): A compound bone consisting of maxilla and palatine, can also contain a prefrontal and/or lacrimal; present in adult Gymnophiona.

(C) uberon-3000291.description: (C): Opening on the postnasal wall for the medial branch (= ramus medialis nasi) of the ophthalmicus nerve.

(C) uberon-3000292.description: (C): In a triradiate pterygoid, the process that extends medially towards the otic capsule.

(C) uberon-3000294.description: (C): Anterior projection of the septum nasi that protrudes through the anterior nasal wall.

(C) uberon-3000323.description: (C): A compound bone consisting of premaxilla, nasal and sometimes septomaxilla in adult members of Caeciliidae and Typhlonectidae.

(C) uberon-3000329.description: (C): Semi-circular cartilaginous sheet that lies lateral to the side of the septum nasi.

(C) uberon-3000344.description: (C): Foramen that forms a passage for one of the branches of the trigeminal nerve into the nasal region.

(C) uberon-3000347.description: (C): Ossified posterior articular portion of Meckel's cartilage.

(C) uberon-3000348.description: (C): A bone that forms both the floor of the braincase and the posterior part of the skull.

(C) uberon-3000364.description: (C): Osseous expansion of the posterior and medial rami of the pterygoid.

(C) uberon-3000367.description: (C): Ramus (process) that extends medially toward the otic capsule.

(C) uberon-3000372.description: (C): Sliver of bone that invest part of or all the posterior aspect of each antorbital plane.

body: [obsolete palatine process of pars palatina of premaxilla](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_3000374)
(C) uberon-3000374.label_original: obsolete palatine process of pars palatina of premaxilla

body: [palatine process of the pars facialis of the maxilla](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_3000375)
(C) uberon-3000375.label_original: palatine process of the pars facialis of the maxilla

(C) uberon-3000381.description: (C): Cartilaginous bridge that extends posteriorly to the anterolateral corner of the posterior nasal wall.

(C) uberon-3000386.description: (C): Process that extends anteriorly from the orbitotemporal region.

(C) uberon-3000387.description: (C): Paired processes extending lateraly from the posterior body of the parasphenoid that, when present, support the otic capsules ventrally.

(C) uberon-3000389.description: (C): Paired, elongate, ventrolaterally-orieted cartilaginous structures that extend to the premaxilla-maxilla articulation.

(C) uberon-3000394.description: (C): Posterior end of Meckel's cartilage that forms the articular head of the mandibular arch.

(C) uberon-3000406.description: (C): Plate-like structure that lies in the fenestra ovalis. It arises within the membrana opercularis in the posterior part of the fenestra.

(C) uberon-3000413.description: (C): Lingual ledge on the inner surface of the maxilla.

(C) uberon-3000414.description: (C): Lingual ledge on the inner surface of the premaxilla.

(C) uberon-3000428.description: (C): Consists of enlarged cistern against which the operculum and footplate of the columella rest in the oval window. Together with the endolymphatic systems comprises the membranous labryinth of the inner ear. Duellman and Trueb 1994.

(C) uberon-3000431.description: (C): A strut of cartilage  extending dorsally from the basal plate and with other similar cartilages forming the sides of the brain case. The pila antoptica is posterior to pila metoptica together with which it may enclose the foramen for the ocular motor nerve and opthalmica magna artery.

(C) uberon-3000432.description: (C): A strut of cartilage  extending dorsally from the basal plate and with other similar cartilages forming the sides of the brain case. The pila metoptica is anterior to pila antoptica together with which it may enclose the foramen for the ocular motor nerve and opthalmica magna artery. Anterior to the pila antoptica is the pila preoptica (another pillar of cartilage) between these two cartilages emerges the optic and trochlear nerves.

(C) uberon-3000440.description: (C): Vertical plate of cartilage that is fused posterodorsally to the oblique cartilage and anteriorly to the lamina inferior.

(C) uberon-3000441.description: (C): Cartilaginous, distal expansion of the lamina orbitonasalis that invests the pars facialis of the maxilla medially.

(C) uberon-3000448.description: (C): Process that extends posteriorly from the planum triangulare and invests the maxilla laterally and the anterior ramus of the pterygoid medially.

(C) uberon-3000451.description: (C): In a triradiate pterygoid, the process that extends posterolaterally towards the jaw articulation.

(C) uberon-3000454.description: (C): Paired, anteriorly concave structures that form the posterior limit of nasal capsule. It consists of two parts: a ventral piece, the lamina orbitonasalis, and a dorsal plate that is part of the tectum nasi.

(C) uberon-3000459.description: (C): Point of insertion of the masticatory musculature.

body: [preorbital process of the pars facialis of the maxilla](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_3000467)
(C) uberon-3000467.label_original: preorbital process of the pars facialis of the maxilla

(C) uberon-3000486.description: (C): Cartilaginous or ligamentous connection between the pars externa plectri and the crista parotica.

(C) uberon-3000492.description: (C): Posterior part of the corpus of the septomaxilla; the posterior surface of the processus infrafenestralis is in contact with the oblique cartilage.

(C) uberon-3000494.description: (C): Dorsolateral process of the of the medial ramus of the pterygoid.

(C) uberon-3000500.description: (C): Posterior, toothless portion of the maxilla by which it usually comes in contact with the quadratojugal.

(C) uberon-3000505.description: (C): Posterior end of the pars palatina of the maxilla that is in contact with the anterior ramus of the pterygoid.

(C) uberon-3000512.description: (C): Posterodorsal extension of the maxilla by which it establishes contact with the squamosal.

(C) uberon-3000518.description: (C): Compound bone of adult Gymnophiona, consisting of dentary, coronoid and mentomeckelian.

(C) uberon-3000521.description: (C): Palatal bones of intramembranous origin that lie anterior to the otic capsules, lateral to the orbits, and medial to the maxillae.

(C) uberon-3000523.description: (C): Process that extends anteriorly from the anterolateral margin of the palatoquadrate and articulates or synchondrotically fuses to the posterior end of the posterior maxillary process.

(C) uberon-3000539.description: (C): Is a recess on the surface of the premaxilla near to the base of the pars facialis.

(C) uberon-3000540.description: (C): Is a space on the interior surface of the pars facialis of the maxilla.

(C) uberon-3000543.description: (C): Bony process that is part of the articular and is the point of insertion of the m. interhuoideus posterior.

(C) uberon-3000547.description: (C): Is a process of the nasal bone directed anteriorly towards the rostrum.

(C) uberon-3000560.description: (C): The anterior connective tissue partition between walls of otic capsule around which the membranous semicircular canals pass.

(C) uberon-3000561.description: (C): The lateral connective tissue partition between walls of otic capsule around which the membranous semicircular canals pass.

(C) uberon-3000562.description: (C): The posterior connective tissue partition between walls of otic capsule around which the membranous semicircular canals pass.

(C) uberon-3000565.description: (C): Elevation of the dorsal surface of the solum nasi medial to the fenestra endochoanalis that provides support for the eminentia olfactoria.

(C) uberon-3000569.description: (C): Unpaired, horizontal plate that forms the floor of the nasal capsule.

(C) uberon-3000572.description: (C): Endochondral bone that forms the anterior portion of the braincase and forms from one ossification center on each side of the orbital cartilage.

(C) uberon-3000581.description: (C): Groove located between the pars dentalis and the bases of the maxillary teeth.

(C) uberon-3000582.description: (C): Groove located between the pars dentalis and the bases of the premaxillary teeth.

(C) uberon-3000583.description: (C): A groove on the palatoquadrate that is occupied by the Meckel's cartilage.

(C) uberon-3000586.description: (C): Paired, elongate cartilages that extend anteroventrally to abut the dorsomedial margin of the posterior face of the alary process of the premaxilla. The function of these cartilages is to transmit the movement of the premaxilla to the alary cartilages during the closure of the apertura nasalis externa.

(C) uberon-3000587.description: (C): The suprangular or surangular is a jaw bone found in most land vertebrates, except mammals. It's usually in the back of the jaw, on the upper edge, and is connected to all other jaw bones: dentary, angular, splenial and articular. It is often a muscle attachment site.

(C) uberon-3000588.description: (C): Median, unpaired bone that can form the dorsal margin of the foramen magnum.

(C) uberon-3000591.description: (C): Endochondral ossification of the dorsomedial portion of the braincase.

(C) uberon-3000599.description: (C): Cartilaginous connection between the orbital cartilage and otic capsules.

(C) uberon-3000601.description: (C): Roof of the nasal capsule, confluent with lamina orbitonasalis posteriorly and united to septum nasi.

(C) uberon-3000619.description: (C): Central, funnel-shaped, ossified portion of the tympanic annulus fused to the squamosal bone.

(C) uberon-3000628.description: (C): Longest of the three squamosal rami; it invests the dorsolateral margin of the palatoquadrate. The distal end of the ventral ramus invests the quadrate and articulates with the quadratojugal.

(C) uberon-3000639.description: (C): Ramus (process) that projects anteriorly from the dorsal body of the squamosal and forms part of the posterior margin of the orbit.

(C) uberon-3000640.description: (C): Skeletal structure that separates the inferior and superior perilymphatic foramina.

(C) uberon-3000644.description: (C): Rod-shaped process that extends caudally from the inferior edge of the planum terminale.

(C) uberon-3000646.description: (C): Anterior, rounded portion of the corpus of the septomaxilla.

(C) uberon-3000647.description: (C): Sharp ridge that extends medially from the basal part of the processus infrafenestralis; it separates the diverticulum proncipale from the diverticulum medium.

(C) uberon-3000648.description: (C): Synchondrotic or synostotic connection between the footplate of the pars media plectri and the ventral margin of the fenestra ovalis.

(C) uberon-3000649.description: (C): Process that extends anterolaterally toward the maxilla-premaxilla articulation.

(C) uberon-3000650.description: (C): Anterio portion of the maxilla that may contact the nasal and take part in the formation of a groove for the nasolacrimal duct.

(C) uberon-3000651.description: (C): Most anterior part of the maxilla, which is in contact with the premaxilla.

(C) uberon-3000652.description: (C): Depression lacated on the inner surface of the maxilla between the palatine process and the pars palatina.

(C) uberon-3000653.description: (C): Portion of the quadratojugal that makes contact dorsally with the distal portion of the squamosal.

(C) uberon-3000654.description: (C): Anterior part of the quadratojugal that is in contact with the processus posterior of the maxilla.

(C) uberon-3000655.description: (C): Dorsal process of the lamella alaris located at the anterior end of the margo orbitalis; a narrow ligament that runs from the frontoparietal is attached to it.

(C) uberon-3000656.description: (C): Posterior process of the lamella alaris.

(C) uberon-3000658.description: (C): Process that extends laterally from the anterior process; its bifurcation from the postchoanal process occurs at the level of the dentigerous process.

(C) uberon-3000659.description: (C): Process that extends laterally from the anterior process; its bifurcation from the prechoanal process occurs at the level of the dentigerous process.

(C) uberon-3000660.description: (C): Margin between the prechoanal and postchoanal process. It bounds the fenestra endochoanalis.

(C) uberon-3000661.description: (C): Ridge on the dorsal surface of the vomer that runs from the anterior to the postchoanal processes of the vomer; it takes part in the fixation of the bone to the lateral margin of the solum nasi.

(C) uberon-3000662.description: (C): Posterior projection of the median part of the parsphenoid, which may extend over the posterior margins of the subotic alae.

(C) uberon-3000664.description: (C): Azygous or paired bone that occurs on the ventral surface of the hyoid plate.

(C) uberon-3000667.description: (C): Area of fusion of the ceratohyals.

(C) uberon-3000668.description: (C): Is the space along the anterior edge of the hyoid plate between the hyale and through which passes the hyoglossus muscle as it passes dorsally into the tongue.

(C) uberon-3000671.description: (C): Processes that flank the hyales laterally and extend anterolaterally from the anterolateral margin of the hyoid plate. They are formed as a result of new cartilaginous growth lateral to the basibranchial.

(C) uberon-3000672.description: (C): Paired processes that extend posterolaterally from the posterolateral margin of the hyoid plate. These processes are formed as a result of new cartilaginous growth lateral to the basibranchial and hypobranchial plate.

(C) uberon-3000673.description: (C): Cartilaginous, paired processes that extend posterolaterally from the posterior margin of the hyoid plate. These processes invest the laryngeal apparatus and are ossified in the adult.

(C) uberon-3000676.description: (C): Paired processes that extend posteroventrally from the anterolateral margins of the cricoid ring.

(C) uberon-3000678.description: (C): Median process located on the posterior end of the cricoid cartilage.

(C) uberon-3000683.description: (C): Depression that houses the hypoglossus nerve and is located between the anterolateral process and the proximal part of the hyale.

(C) uberon-3000685.description: (C): Foramen that houses the hypoglossus nerve and is located between the anterolateral process and the proximal part of the hyale.

(C) uberon-3000687.description: (C): Strip of cartilage that forms the lateral margin of the foramen nervi hypoglossi.

(C) uberon-3000688.description: (C): Anterior end of the arytenoid cartilage.

(C) uberon-3000689.description: (C): Posterior (cardiac) end of the arytenoid cartilage.

(C) uberon-3000692.description: (C): Paired stalks located dorsolateral to the vertebral centrum that provide support to the lateral margins of the neural arch laminae.

(C) uberon-3000694.description: (C): Anterior, single or paired concave facets for articulation with the condyle(s) of the urostyle.

(C) uberon-3000696.description: (C): Indentation on the anterior margin of the pedicel. When two vertebrae articulate, the anterior notch of one vertebra and the posterior notch of the other create a bilateral intervertebral space.

(C) uberon-3000701.description: (C): Space formed by the anterior and posterior intervertebral notches. The intervertebral spaces accommodate the spinal nerves as they emerge from the spinal canal.

(C) uberon-3000704.description: (C): Indentation on the posterior margin of the pedicel. When two vertebrae articulate, the anterior notch of one vertebra and the posterior notch of the other create a bilateral intervertebral space.

(C) uberon-3000707.description: (C): Paired processes that represent the rib attachments to the vertebra plus the ribs.

(C) uberon-3000711.description: (C): Holochordal vertebral centra that are concave anteriorly and convex posteriorly; they bear a condyle on the posterior end for the articulation with the posterior adjacent vertebral centrum, forming a ball-and-socket joint that allows extensive motion in most directions.

(C) uberon-3000712.description: (C): Ectochordal or stegochordal vertebral centra that are convex anteriorly and concave posteriorly; they bear a condyle on the anterior end for the articulation with the posterior adjacent vertebral centrum, forming a ball-and-socket joint that allows extensive motion in most directions.

(C) uberon-3000713.description: (C): Vertebral centrum that originates from ossification of the dorsal portion of the perichordal tube; the resulting element tends to be depressed in cross section.

(C) uberon-3000714.description: (C): Vertebral centrum that originates from ossification of the entire perichordal tube; the resulting element is cylindrical in cross section and may have an open (notochord retained) or solid center.

(C) uberon-3000715.description: (C): Vertebral centrum that bears saddle-shaped articular surfaces at both ends, having a convexity in the right-left axis and a concavity in the dorsoventral axis. This morphology allows great lateral and vertical flexion.

(C) uberon-3000716.description: (C): Vertebral centrum with flat ends. Between successive vertebrae there is a fibrocartilaginous intervertebral body with a gel-like core, the nucleus pulposus, which is derived from the embryonic notochord. Acoelous vertebrae seem especially suited to receive and distribute compressive forces within the vertebral column.

(C) uberon-3000717.description: (C): Ectochordal, biconcave or terminally flat vertebral centrum. This design seems to allow limited motion in most directions. An intervertebral body (which may or may not be independent from the adjacent centra) fills the cavity between successive centra. The intervertebral body usually is formed by soft material that may be derived, at least in part, from the embryonic notochord.

(C) uberon-3000718.description: (C): Spool-shaped vertebral centrum with an open center in which the notochord lies.

(C) uberon-3000719.description: (C): Spool-shaped vertebral centrum with a solid center. All traces of the notochord dissapear.

(C) uberon-3000720.description: (C): Vertebral centrum that is depressed dorsoventrally and solid. All traces of the notochord dissapear.

(C) uberon-3000727.description: (C): Paired plates that form the haemal arch. The lateral margin of each lamina is firmly attached to the ventral surface of the caudal vertebral centrum and the medial end fuses to the medial end of the opposite lamina.

(C) uberon-3000728.description: (C): Longitudinal process found in all cervical vertebrae, except the atlas, for the attachment of dorsal head musculature.

(C) uberon-3000730.description: (C): Opening on the lateral side of the vertebra for the passage of blood vessels.

(C) uberon-3000735.description: (C): Ridge-shaped structure present on the dorsomedial surface of the neural arch lamina; this structure is produced at the point of junction of the contralateral sides of each neural arch.

(C) uberon-3000736.description: (C): Ridge on the ventral aspect of the humeral shaft. It serves for the attachment of the mm pectoralis and shoulder musculature used primarily for limb adduction.

(C) uberon-3000743.description: (C): Anterior, paired convex facets for articulation with the cotyle(s) of the urostyle.

(C) uberon-3000744.description: (C): Anterior, single or paired concave facets for articulation with the sacral condyle(s).

(C) uberon-3000745.description: (C): In anurans, pair of bony plates that connect the posteromedial margins of the sacral diapophyses with the lateral margins of the anterior portion of the urostyle.
(C) uberon-3000745.label_original: webbing of bone in vertebral column

(C) uberon-3000746.description: (C): Longitudinal crest on the dorsal side of the urostyle formed by the caudal neural arches.

(C) uberon-3000748.description: (C): Paired, cartilaginous elements located in the dorsolateral shoulder region. Each suprascapula is a flat broad blade that extends medially.

(C) uberon-3000752.description: (C): Prominent structure (anteromedial head) that forms the anterior section of the ventral margin of the scapula.

(C) uberon-3000753.description: (C): Concave structure (posteromedial head) that forms the posterior head of the ventral margin of the scapula. The pars glenoidalis articulates with the humerus, and comprises the dorsal portion of the glenoid fossa.

(C) uberon-3000756.description: (C): Small hooked process on the dorsal aspect of the humeral shaft; it does not extend on to the glenoid head. The m subscapularis is inserted on it.

(C) uberon-3000757.description: (C): All those parts of the pectoral girdle ventral and medial to the glenoid fossa.

(C) uberon-3000759.description: (C): Proximal portion of the prezonal element of the pectoral girdle. It may be a flat, midventral cartilaginous structure or a calcified or bony element elaborated into a stylum.

(C) uberon-3000762.description: (C): Paired, flat cartilaginous arches that compose the central portion of the zonal area, unites the clavicle and coracoid of each half of the pectoral girdle, and form the medial margins of the pectoral fenestrae.

(C) uberon-3000763.description: (C): A pair of cartilaginous expansions (one from each epicoracoid cartilage) that project anteriorly. They articulate anteriorly with the omosternum.

(C) uberon-3000771.description: (C): The central, most concave portion of the acetabulum, which remains open.

(C) uberon-3000773.description: (C): Longitudinal crest on the dorsal side of the shaft of the ilium.

(C) uberon-3000774.description: (C): Anterior rod that articulates with the sacrum.

(C) uberon-3000775.description: (C): Posterior body of the ilium that forms the anterior half of the acetabulum.

(C) uberon-3000777.description: (C): A pair of cartilaginous expansions (one from each epicoracoid cartilage) that project posteriorly. They articulate with the sternum by means of grooves, pouches or fossae in the dorsal surface of the sternum and provide a site for the insertion of a pair of muscles derived from the m. rectus abdominis.

(C) uberon-3000779.description: (C): Ovoid space on the pectoral girdle limited anteriorly by the procoracoid, medially by the epicoracoid, and posteriorly by the coracoid.

(C) uberon-3000780.description: (C): Notch that separates the cartilaginous regions of the procoracoid and coracoid.

(C) uberon-3000783.description: (C): Ovoid roughened pit, which is situated a little below and behind the center of the head, and serves as a site of attachment for ligaments.

(C) uberon-3000784.description: (C): Semi-elliptical ball located at the lower end of the humerus, adjacent to the humeral ball.

(C) uberon-3000785.description: (C): Furrow between the humeral head and the ulnar condyle.

(C) uberon-3000786.description: (C): Depresion on the distal end of the humerus, just anterior to the humeral head, in which the end of the radius fits when the forelimb is flexed.

(C) uberon-3000787.description: (C): In a fused radio-ulna, the proximal portion of the compound bone (where the sulcus longitudinalis is barely evident or absent) is a cylindrical pillar.

(C) uberon-3000792.description: (C): Subdivision of the cleithrum that extends along the anterior edge of the suprascapula.

(C) uberon-3000793.description: (C): Stegochordal slightly biconcave or flat terminally vertebral centrum. Each intervertebral cartilage is subdivided anteriorly and posteriorly, producing a free intervertebral element between adjacent vertebrae. This element subsequently ossifies and remains free.

(C) uberon-3000794.description: (C): Vertebral column in which the first seven vertebrae have holochordal centra and the intervertebral cartilages are posteriorly subdivided in the procoelous manner. The eighth presacral vertebra has a holochordal centrum and the intervertebral cartilage is subdivided in the opisthocoelous manner. Thus, the first seven presacral vertebrae are concave anteriorly and convex posteriorly, whereas the eighth is biconcave.

(C) uberon-3000796.description: (C): Overlapping neural arches that obscure the spinal cord dorsally.

(C) uberon-3000797.description: (C): Neural arches that do not overlap, thus exposing the spinal cord dorsally.

(C) uberon-3000798.description: (C): Dorsal, dermal plate of bone that overlies the presacral vertebrae. Such shield usually has irregular, sculptured surfaces, frequently is broadly expanded, and may be composed of several separate plates.

(C) uberon-3000799.description: (C): Strip of cartilage that separates the coracoid from the scapula.

(C) uberon-3000801.description: (C): Convex articular facet of the vertebral centrum for the articulation with the adjacent centrum.

(C) uberon-3000802.description: (C): Concave articular facet of the vertebral centrum for the articulation with the adjacent centrum.

(C) uberon-3000803.description: (C): In a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the lateral canal between the carina distalis and the carina medialis.

(C) uberon-3000804.description: (C): In a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the medial canal between the carina medialis and the carina proximalis.

(C) uberon-3000805.description: (C): In a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the proximal ridge.

(C) uberon-3000806.description: (C): In a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the medial ridge.

(C) uberon-3000807.description: (C): In a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the distal ridge.

(C) uberon-3000808.description: (C): Paired, posteriorly directed process at the posterior margin of each neural arch lamina.

(C) uberon-3000809.description: (C): Paired, additional vertebral articulations located medial to the intervertebral space, adjacent to the vertebral centrum.

(C) uberon-3000810.description: (C): Medial groove in the longitudinal ridge of the urostyle formed by the incomplete dorsal fusion of the caudal neural arches.

(C) uberon-3000811.description: (C): Lateral end of the clavicle, which usually lies in close proximity to the pars acromialis of the scapula, and occassionally may fuse to it.

(C) uberon-3000813.description: (C): Canal on the posterior aspect of the clavicle that accomodates the anterior margin of the procoracoid cartilage.

(C) uberon-3000814.description: (C): Lateral end of the coracoid, which forms the medial portion of the glenoid fossa.

(C) uberon-3000815.description: (C): Medial end of the coracoid, which is synchondrotically fused to the epicoracoid cartilage.

(C) uberon-3000816.description: (C): Anterior margin of the coracoid, which forms the posterior edge of the pectoral fenestra.

(C) uberon-3000819.description: (C): Inferior margin of the pars acromialis of the scapula, which articulates with the clavicule.

(C) uberon-3000821.description: (C): Superior margin of the scapula, which articulates with the suprascapula.

(C) uberon-3000822.description: (C): Superior portion of the scapula, which is thinner than the rest of the shaft.

(C) uberon-3000823.description: (C): Notch or indentation between the pars glenoidalis and pars acromialis of the scapula.

(C) uberon-3000824.description: (C): Leading (anterior) portion of the scapula, which is thinner than the rest of the shaft.

(C) uberon-3000825.description: (C): Longitudinal ridge on the medial (inner) face of the scapula.

(C) uberon-3000827.description: (C): Anterior margin of the anterior ramus of the cleithrum.

(C) uberon-3000828.description: (C): Posterior margin of the posterior ramus of the cleithrum.

(C) uberon-3000829.description: (C): Lateral margin of the suprascapula, which articulates with the scapula.

(C) uberon-3000830.description: (C): Medial margin of the suprascapula, which lies dorsal to the vertebral column.

(C) uberon-3000831.description: (C): Small process of the lamina recurvata that extends laterally toward the scapular-suprascapular articulation.

(C) uberon-3000832.description: (C): Portion of the anterior ramus of the cleithrum that invest the anterior margin of the suprascapula, extending onto its dorsal surface.

(C) uberon-3000833.description: (C): Notch or indentation between the anterior and posterior rami of the cleithrum.

(C) uberon-3000834.description: (C): Portion of the posterior ramus of the cleithrum that invests the posterior margin of the suprascapula, extending onto its dorsal surface.

(C) uberon-3000836.description: (C): Ridge on the lateral aspect of the humeral shaft located just anterior to the radial (lateral) epicondyle.

(C) uberon-3000837.description: (C): Ridge on the medial aspect of the humeral shaft that extends from the level of the middle portion of the shaft to ulnar (medial) epicondyle.

(C) uberon-3000839.description: (C): Small ridge on the lateral aspect of the radial shaft, located at the level of the collum antibrachii.

(C) uberon-3000840.description: (C): Lateral portion of the proximal (upper) articular surface of the radius that consists of an eminence with a rounded apex.

(C) uberon-3000841.description: (C): Small eminence on the distal articular head of the radius.

(C) uberon-3000842.description: (C): Small eminence on the distal articular head of the ulna.

(C) uberon-3000844.description: (C): In a fused radio-ulna, longitudinal furrow that demarcates the area of fusion of both elements. This sulcus is deep in the distal portion of the compound bone, but barely evident or absent at the proximal end.

(C) uberon-3000846.description: (C): Oval carpal element that is located on the anteromedial side of the radiale and the anterolateral side of the ulnare. Anteriorly, it articulates with carpals 1 through 4 (or 2 through 5 according to some authors). It is also recognized as centrale by some authors. This element originates from one, two, or three condensation centers. Occasionally it may fuse to carpal 2(1), carpal 3(2), the ulnare, or other elements.

(C) uberon-3000856.description: (C): Small elements present in all digits of the manus, when present in a taxon. Each intercalary element articulates with the anteroventral end of the penultimate phalanx proximally and the distal phalanx distally.

(C) uberon-3000859.description: (C): Opening for the passage of the perforans carpi artery from the ventral to the dorsal side. It perforates the compound ulnare + intermedium.

(C) uberon-3000862.description: (C): Composite element formed by the fusion of the ischium and pubis.

(C) uberon-3000865.description: (C): Dorsal extremity of the ilial shaft, which remains cartilaginous.

(C) uberon-3000866.description: (C): Shelf-like expansion of the ilial corpus that forms the anterior border of the acetabulum.

(C) uberon-3000867.description: (C): Shelf-like expansion of the ischium that forms the posterior border of the acetabulum.

(C) uberon-3000868.description: (C): Dorsal portion of the ilial corpus, located above the acetabulum.

(C) uberon-3000869.description: (C): Small, dorsolaterally projecting knob located just anterior to the supra-acetabular expansion and about the level of the anterior border of the acetabulum.

(C) uberon-3000870.description: (C): Ventral portion of the ilial corpus, located anteroventral to the acetabulum.

(C) uberon-3000871.description: (C): Small depression dorsal to the proximal portion of the collum ilei and ventral to the ilial protuberance.

(C) uberon-3000872.description: (C): Cyllindrical pillar that originates anterior to the acetabulum and extends to the ilial shaft.

(C) uberon-3000873.description: (C): Elongate, cylindrical structure on the ventral side of the shaft of the ilium that extends through its entire length.

(C) uberon-3000874.description: (C): Crest on the posterior side of the ischium, which may also extend to the posteroventral aspect of pubis.

(C) uberon-3000875.description: (C): Small, rounded process on the anterodorsal margin of the ischium, just posterior to the area of articulation with the ilium.

(C) uberon-3000876.description: (C): Small, rounded process on the anteroventral margin of the preacetabular expansion of the ilial corpus.

(C) uberon-3000877.description: (C): Small protuberance on the ischium, located close to its posteroventral margin.

(C) uberon-3000878.description: (C): Small protuberance on the ischium, located at the level of the superior margin of the acetabulum and close to its posterior margin.

(C) uberon-3000879.description: (C): Small indentation on the posterior margin of the ischium, ventral to the intumescentia bilateralis superior.

(C) uberon-3000880.description: (C): Large protuberance on the dorsal aspect of the ischium that extends from the ischio-ilium articulation to the spina pelvis posterior.

(C) uberon-3000882.description: (C): Area of convergence of the ilial shafts. When the preacetabular ilium is narrow, the interilial configuration is V-shaped or narrowly rounded, whereas when the interilial region is broadly expanded the interilial configuration is U-shaped.

(C) uberon-3000883.description: (C): Area dorsal to the pelvic girdle symphysis, between the dorsal portions of the ilial corpora, where lies the posterior terminus of the urostyle.

(C) uberon-3000884.description: (C): Small prepubic element formed by a plate of cartilage (which may calcify in the adult) that is synchondrotically united with the pubis.

(C) uberon-3000885.description: (C): Paired cartilaginous rods that lie within the copulatory organ (or so-called tail) and are attached to the posteroventral part of the pelvic girdle.

(C) uberon-3000886.description: (C): Y-shaped cartilage lying in the middle line, anterior to the pubo-ischium with which it articulates. It lies dorsal to the rectus abdominis muscle with which it articulates.

(C) uberon-3000894.description: (C): Low crest that arises just behind the acetabular head and extends distally for about one-third the length of the femoral shaft.

(C) uberon-3000895.description: (C): Canal on the posteroventral surface of the femoral head, which articulates with the ischial process on the rim of the acetabulum.

(C) uberon-3000896.description: (C): Ovoid roughened pit situated on the dorsal and anteroventral surface of the acetabular head wherein the ligaments attaching the bone to the acetabulum are inserted.

(C) uberon-3000898.description: (C): Paired ridges on the ventral surface of the femoral shaft that run toward the femoral trochanter; the posterior crest is less developed.

(C) uberon-3000903.description: (C): Ridge that arises from the dorso-masial side of the extensor surface of the tibia. It receives the insertion of the tendon of the extensor ilio-tibialis muscle.

(C) uberon-3000904.description: (C): Swelling on the extensor surface of the distal head of the tibiofibula.

(C) uberon-3000905.description: (C): Proximal head of the tibiofibula that articulates with the distal head of the femur.

(C) uberon-3000906.description: (C): Small canal on the proximal head of to the tibiofibula, lateral to the apophysis distalis, for the insertion of the cruris brevis muscle.
(C) uberon-3000906.label_original: sulcus pro musculo extensori cruris brevis

(C) uberon-3000907.description: (C): Small crest on the extensor surface of the proximal head of the tibiofibula (tibial side).

(C) uberon-3000908.description: (C): In a fused tibiofibula, longitudinal furrow in the distal portion of the compound bone that demarcates the area of fusion of both elements.

(C) uberon-3000909.description: (C): In a fused tibiofibula, longitudinal furrow in the proximal portion of the compound bone that demarcates the area of fusion of both elements.

(C) uberon-3000911.description: (C): Foramen for the tibial artery and vein and the deep peroneal nerve; it pierces through the midpoint of the shaft of the tibiofibula.

(C) uberon-3000915.description: (C): Separation of the tibiale and fibulare along their longitudinal axia.

(C) uberon-3000916.description: (C): Swelling on the extensor surface of the proximal compound head of the tibiale and fibulare.

(C) uberon-3000917.description: (C): Swelling on the extensor surface of the distal compound head of the tibiale and fibulare.

(C) uberon-3000921.description: (C): Oval tarsal element that is located on the anteromedial side of the tibiale. Anteriorly, it articulates with the proximal prehallux, tarsals 1, 2, and 3.

(C) uberon-3000931.description: (C): Small elements present in all digits of the pes, when present in a taxon. Each intercalary element articulates with the anteroventral end of the penultimate phalanx proximally and the distal phalanx distally.

(C) uberon-3000934.description: (C): Small opening between the centrale and fibulare that allows the perforans tarsi artery to pass from the ventral to the dorsal side of the ankle.

(C) uberon-3000935.description: (C): Dorso-lateral portion of the pectoral girdle.

(C) uberon-3000936.description: (C): All those parts of the pectoral girdle in the central region of the zonal area.

(C) uberon-3000937.description: (C): All those parts of the pectoral girdle that lie anterior to the zonal area.

(C) uberon-3000938.description: (C): All those parts of the pectoral girdle that lies posterior to the zonal area.

(C) uberon-3000941.description: (C): Pectoral girdle in which the epicoracoid cartilages are elaborated into posteriorly directed epicoracoid horns. Most arciferal pectoral girdles are characterized by fusion of the epicoracoid cartilages in the interclavicle region. Posterior to the clavicles, the epicoracoids usually are free and overlapping.

(C) uberon-3000942.description: (C): Pectoral girdle that lacks epicoracoid horns. The sternum is fused to the pectoral arch, and the epicoracoid cartilages of each half of the girdle are fused to one another. The midzonal length of the girdle is shorter than that of an arciferal girdle, but pre- and postzonal elements tend to be longer.

(C) uberon-3000943.description: (C): Modified arciferal pectoral girdle in which the fusion of the epicoracoid cartilages in the interclavicle region is extended posteriorly. Thus, the cartilages no longer overlap freely, and functionally a partially firmisternal condition is created.

(C) uberon-3000944.description: (C): Modified firmisternal pectoral girdle in which the epicoracoid cartilages are partly free and overlapping; however, the epicoracoids are fused to one another and the sternum postermodially.

(C) uberon-3000945.description: (C): Three pairs of cartilaginous elements posterior to the sternum that lie in the myosepta of the ventral trunk musculature.

(C) uberon-3000948.description: (C): Paired processes located on the anterior end of the cricoid cartilage.

(C) uberon-3000949.description: (C): Laminar subdivision of the cleithrum that extends along the ventral (lateral) midbody of the suprascapula.

(C) uberon-3000950.description: (C): Small, broadly triangular bar of bone lying across the ventral side of the pharynx at the junction of the M. genio-hyoideus and the M. rectus cervicis superficialis.

(C) uberon-3000951.description: (C): Paired, horn-like processes of basibranchial I that protrude in an antero-dorso-lateral direction, being more or less embedded in the tongue musculature. These elements contitute the hypohyals.

(C) uberon-3000952.description: (C): Paired, horn-like processes of basibranchial I that protrude in an antero-dorso-lateral direction, being more or less embedded in the tongue musculature. They arise secondarily during metamorphosis, and are therefore not strictly part of the visceral skeleton.

(C) uberon-3000953.description: (C): Paired bars that articulate with hypobranchial II. Reduction of loss of these elements is common in salamanders.

(C) uberon-3000954.description: (C): Paired bar that articulates with basibranchial I. It forms the anterior portion of the posterior cornu of the hyoid.

(C) uberon-3000955.description: (C): Paired bar that articulates with, or is fused to, hypobranchial I. It forms the posterior portion of the posterior cornu of the hyoid.

(C) uberon-3000956.description: (C): Paired bar that articulates anteriorly with basibranchial I and posteriorly with ceratobranchials II--IV.

(C) uberon-3000957.description: (C): Paired, anterior element that articulates medially with basibranchial I and posterolaterally with the paired hypohyals.

(C) uberon-3000966.description: (C): Dermal bone of anuran lower jaw investing lingual and ventral surfaces of Meckel's cartilage; forming coronoid process and articulating with palatoquadrate posteriorly.

(C) uberon-3000992.description: (C): The largest part of the nasal cavity, containing the olfactory epithelium.

(C) uberon-3000998.description: (C): Larval upper jaws articulate with trabecular horns.

(C) uberon-3010007.description: (C): Mechanoreceptive organ of the lateral line, smaller than neuromasts, they are located on the surface of the epidermis. These receptors receive afferent and efferent innervation.

(C) uberon-3010018.description: (C): Originates from the superior process of the ilium and inserts on the aponeuronis of the M. cruralis.

(C) uberon-3010022.description: (C): Originates on the ventro-lateral aspect of the ala ossis ilei and the ventral surface of the iliacus externus. Inserts on the lateral surface of the cruralis, the dorso-lateral surface of the gluteus magnus, and on the aponeurosis of the cruralis.

(C) uberon-3010027.description: (C): Originates on the ventral pelvic rim, the pubic region, and the ventral surface of the adductor longus. The insertion bifurcates distally; the ventral portion attaches to the aponeurosis of the cruralis and the dorsal part attaches to the distal attachment of the gracilis major, the semitendinosus, and to the aponeurosis of the cruralis.

(C) uberon-3010029.description: (C): Multi-cellular organism that has male and female sexes.

(C) uberon-3010032.description: (C): Originates by two tendons: one on the postero-ventral aspect of the pelvic rim, the other, a dorsal tendon from the postero-dorsal pelvic rim under the ventral edge of M. semimembranosus. Inserts on the ventral surface of the tibiofibula.

(C) uberon-3010039.description: (C): Sequential hermaphroditic organism that produces gametes first of the male sex, and then later of the female sex.

(C) uberon-3010042.description: (C): Sequential hermaphroditic organism that produces gametes first of the female sex, and then later of the male sex.

(C) uberon-3010045.description: (C): Distal-most centrale when two are present.

(C) uberon-3010047.description: (C): Originates on the ventro-lateral border of the ischium and inserts on the ventro-medial surface of the femur at the base of caput femoris.

(C) uberon-3010049.description: (C): Originates from the dorso-lateral margin of the ischium and inserts on the medial surface of the femur.

(C) uberon-3010058.description: (C): A dermal fold surrounding the body reflecting body segmentation. Found in Caecilians.

(C) uberon-3010060.description: (C): Rectangular cartilage or bone between the distal basal commune and the proximal intermedium.

(C) uberon-3010061.description: (C): Cartilage that bridges palatoquadrate to ethmoid region.

(C) uberon-3010065.description: (C): Originates by a broad tendon from the postero-ventral surface of the pelvic rim and inserts by two tendons. One broad tendon inserts on the knee aponeurosis, and in part on the ventro-medial surface of the tibiofibula. The other long tendon inserts on the posterior surface of the tibiofibula just below the proximal head.

(C) uberon-3010067.description: (C): Originates from the pelvic rim just ventral to the anus and merges with M. gracilis major. M. gracilis minor also attaches to the skin.

(C) uberon-3010068.description: (C): Originates on the ventro-lateral surface of the ischium below the anus and inserts on the ventro-medial aspect of the femur and the head of the tibiofibula by a stout tendon, which is formed by the ventral origin of the plantaris longus.

(C) uberon-3010069.description: (C): Quadrangular cartilage or bone lying between the preaxial radiale and the postaxial ulnare in the proximal level of the mesopodium.

(C) uberon-3010070.description: (C): Originates from the ventral border of the ala ossis ilei just posterior to the origin of M. glutaeus maximus. Insterts in the aponeurosis covering the knee joint.

(C) uberon-3010072.description: (C): Originates on the dorso-lateral border of the distal urostyle and inserts on the dorsal surface of the crista femoris. This muscle inserts between the M. ilio-fibularis/M. glutaeus magnus and M. semimembranosus.

(C) uberon-3010073.description: (C): The proximal-most rectangular cartilage or bone when two centralelia are present.

(C) uberon-3010074.description: (C): Originates from the postero-ventral surface of the ala ossis ilei and from the insertion tendon of M. ileo-fibularis. Inserts along the dorso-medial border of the femur.

(C) uberon-3010076.description: (C): Muscle originates on the ventral border of the ala ossis ilei to insert on the dorso-medial surface of the femur.

(C) uberon-3010078.description: (C): Originates on the ventral and lateral surfaces of the ala ossis ilei and inserts on the postero-dorsal face of the caput femoris.

(C) uberon-3010082.description: (C): Originates along the connective tissue covering the dorsal surface of the lung and inserts on the dorsal surface of the femur. Muscle found only in Pipa.

(C) uberon-3010084.description: (C): Originates on the entire medial surface of the shaft of the tibiofibula. Inserts on the tibiale by a long tendon proximo-lateral to the insertion of the medial belly of M. tibialis anticus longus.

(C) uberon-3010087.description: (C): Originates on the ventro-lateral surface of the medial condyle of the femur. Its tendon extends in a groove over the knee in the lateral surface of the tibiofibular head, and penetrates the M. peroneus tendon. Insertion is by a lateral and medial head on the dorso-lateral surface of the fibulare and the medial border of the proximal end of the tibiale respectively.

(C) uberon-3010089.description: (C): Originates by a slender tendon from the ventral surface of the medial condyle of the femur and passes over the knee to insert as a fleshy belly on the ventro-lateral surface of the tibiofibula.

(C) uberon-3010090.description: (C): Originates from the dorso-lateral surface of the tibiofibula and inserts on the proximo-medial surface of the tibiale dorsal to the medial head of M. tibialis anticus longus.

(C) uberon-3010092.description: (C): A process of the otic capsule that will bridge to the palatoquadrate basal process.

(C) uberon-3010093.description: (C): Small hair or nipple like projection on the integument.

(C) uberon-3010094.description: (C): Process that projects from anterior margin of commissure as site of attachment for quadratoethmoid ligament.

(C) uberon-3010097.description: (C): Originates on the medial border of the ligamentum calcanei and inserts along the ventral surface of the tibiale.

(C) uberon-3010098.description: (C): Originates on the medial half of the ligamentum calcanei and inserts along the dorsal surface of the aponeurosis plantaris and extends to the level of the base of the prehallux.

(C) uberon-3010099.description: (C): Cranial nerve III innervated; dorsal in the rectus group.

(C) uberon-3010101.description: (C): Cranial nerve III innervated; ventral in the rectus group.

(C) uberon-3010105.description: (C): Sensory nerve of the anterior lateral line component. It develops from the preotic anterodorsal placode. ADLLN branches into two rami innervating orbital lines of neuromasts.

(C) uberon-3010109.description: (C): Sensory nerve of the anterior lateral line component. It develops from preotic anteroventral placode. AVLLN innervates lower jaw lines of neuromasts.

(C) uberon-3010113.description: (C): Cranial nerve III innervated; medial in the rectus group.

(C) uberon-3010115.description: (C): Sensory nerve of the posterior lateral line component. It develops from de postotic posterior placode. PLLN innervates the trunk lines of neuromasts.

(C) uberon-3010117.description: (C): Cranial nerve III innverated; ventral in the obliquus group.

(C) uberon-3010118.description: (C): Cartilage that bridges palatoquadrate muscular process to dorsal orbitonasal plate.

(C) uberon-3010125.description: (C): Cranial nerve V innervated; ventral to the eye.

(C) uberon-3010126.description: (C): Sensory nerve of the posterior lateral line component. It develops from the postotic middle placode. MLLN innervates neuromasts located over the otic capsule and the suprabranchial line of neuromasts.

(C) uberon-3010127.label_original: fringe on postaxial edge of finger IV

(C) uberon-3010128.description: (C): Compose lateral rim of frontoparietal fenestra, ventrally confluent with orbital cartilages, posteriorly confluent with tectum synoticum.

(C) uberon-3010130.description: (C): Cartilaginous connection that partitions frontoparietal fenestra into anterior and posterior regions. Often persists form larva into adults.

(C) uberon-3010131.description: (C): Forms lateral walls of braincase, confluent posteriorly with otic capsules via taenia tecti marginalis and anteriorly with lamina orbitonasalis via sphenethmoid commissure.

(C) uberon-3010132.description: (C): Cartilaginous connection between the taenia tecti transversalis to the tectum synoticum, and subdividing the parietal fenestra into left and right fenestrae. Often persist from larva to adult.

(C) uberon-3010136.description: (C): Originates from the anterior surface of the hip joint capsule between the iliacus internus and the pectineus. Inserts by an aponeurosis attaching to the condyles of the femur and on the head of the cruris. This continues over the cruris to cover the tibialis anticus longus and peroneus to insert on the dorsal surface of those muscles.

(C) uberon-3010137.description: (C): Ventral plate anterior to and confluent with ethmoid plate.

(C) uberon-3010142.description: (C): Posterior chondrocranium forming ventral and lateral margins of foramen magnum, medial to otic capsules.

(C) uberon-3010144.description: (C): Toothlike processes found on the mandible of some anurans; can be formed by dentary or dentary + mentomeckelian bones; odontoids lack enamel and dentine present in true teeth.

(C) uberon-3010145.description: (C): Plate of cartilage occluding fenestra ovalis.

(C) uberon-3010146.description: (C): OBSOLETE. Investing bone in non-teleosts associated with nasolacrimal duct and lying between pars facialis of maxilla and prefrontal and sometimes nasal.

(C) uberon-3010166.label_original: fringe on postaxial edge of toe V

(C) uberon-3010172.description: (C): Is a integumentary structure located on the ventral surface of the hand and/or foot. Found at the junction between, in the hand, the metacarpal and most proximal phalanx of the digit and between phalanges, and in the foot between the metatarsal and most proximal phalanx of the digit and between phalanges.

(C) uberon-3010194.description: (C): A recurrent variant of salamanders; a rhomboidal cartilage lying immediately postaxial from the centrale or centrale 1.

(C) uberon-3010195.description: (C): A small lateral diverticulum of the nasal cavity found in anuran larvae.

(C) uberon-3010197.description: (C): A part of the inferior cavity of the olfactory organ, found in anurans.

(C) uberon-3010205.description: (C): A rounded  cartilage lying in the postaxial margin of the mesopodium, adjacent to the distal end of the fibulare.

(C) uberon-3010217.description: (C): Either of two arteries which carry blood to the head.

(C) uberon-3010218.description: (C): An artery which supplies blood to the muscles of the tongue and floor of the mouth via four major branches.

(C) uberon-3010219.description: (C): An artery which supplies the upper jaw and cranium.

(C) uberon-3010220.description: (C): An anatomical cluster that is part of the cranium and structurally supports the eye.

(C) uberon-3010240.description: (C): Either of a pair of cartilaginous rods that support the intromittent organ of male Ascaphus, and are attached to the posteroventral part of the pelvic girdle.

(C) uberon-3010259.description: (C): Eversible phalloid portion of the cloaca that is inserted in the female's vent during copulation. Found in male Caecillians.

(C) uberon-3010260.description: (C): A tail like posterior extension of the cloaca supported by a pair of Nobelian rods.
